title: 在咖啡店點餐
setting_zh: 你走進一家咖啡店，店員在櫃檯後面招呼你。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Hi there! What can I get for you today?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 點一杯中杯拿鐵，外帶
turns.answer: Can I get a medium latte to go, please?
accept: Can I get a medium latte to go, please?
I'd like a medium latte to go, please.
turns.note_zh: to go 是「外帶」；內用說 for here。Can I get… 比 I want… 禮貌自然。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Sure. Would you like anything to eat with that?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 不用了，謝謝
turns.answer: No thanks, just the latte.
accept: No thanks, just the latte.
No, thank you. Just the coffee.
turns.note_zh: 加上 just the latte 比單講 no thanks 更完整，聽起來不會太生硬。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That'll be four fifty. Can I get a name for the order?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 告訴他你的名字，並問可不可以刷卡
turns.answer: It's Chen. Do you take credit cards?
accept: It's Chen. Do you take credit cards?
Chen. Can I pay by card?
turns.note_zh: 問付款方式用 Do you take…？比 Can I use…？更常見。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Of course. Just tap right here. Your latte will be ready in a moment.

title: 飯店入住
setting_zh: 你剛抵達飯店，帶著行李走到櫃檯。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Good afternoon. Checking in?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 是的，你有訂房，姓陳，要住三晚
turns.answer: Yes, I have a reservation under Chen, for three nights.
accept: Yes, I have a reservation under Chen, for three nights.
Yes, I have a booking under Chen for three nights.
turns.note_zh: under + 姓氏 表示訂位掛在誰名下，是飯店櫃檯的固定說法。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Let me pull that up. Yes, a double room, three nights. May I see your passport?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 把護照給他，並問早餐幾點開始
turns.answer: Here you go. What time does breakfast start?
accept: Here you go. What time does breakfast start?
Here it is. What time is breakfast served?
turns.note_zh: 遞東西給人說 Here you go 最自然，不用說 I give you。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Breakfast is from six thirty to ten on the second floor. Here's your key card, room 812.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問有沒有可能升等到高樓層的房間
turns.answer: Would it be possible to get a room on a higher floor?
accept: Would it be possible to get a room on a higher floor?
Is it possible to have a higher floor room?
turns.note_zh: Would it be possible to…？是提出要求最委婉的句型之一。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Let me check... I can move you to 1508. It has a better view as well.

title: 跟同事聊週末
setting_zh: 星期一早上，同事在茶水間遇到你。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Morning! How was your weekend? Did you do anything interesting?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說還不錯，你跟朋友去爬山了
turns.answer: It was pretty good. I went hiking with some friends.
accept: It was pretty good. I went hiking with some friends.
Pretty good. I went hiking with friends.
turns.note_zh: pretty good 是「還不錯」，比 very good 更貼近日常語氣。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Oh nice, where did you go? I've been meaning to get outdoors more.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說在北部的一座山，天氣很好，並反問對方週末做了什麼
turns.answer: A mountain up north. The weather was perfect. How about you?
accept: A mountain up north. The weather was perfect. How about you?
A mountain in the north. The weather was great. What about you?
turns.note_zh: 閒聊記得反問，How about you? 是最省力的接話方式。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Honestly, I just stayed home and caught up on sleep. I was exhausted.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說那樣也不錯，有時候就是需要休息
turns.answer: That sounds good too. Sometimes you just need the rest.
accept: That sounds good too. Sometimes you just need the rest.
That sounds nice too. Sometimes you just need to rest.
turns.note_zh: That sounds… 是回應對方經驗最通用的句型。

title: 面試：談經歷與動機
setting_zh: 你正在進行一場軟體工程師的面試，面試官剛請你坐下。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Thanks for coming in. To start, could you tell me a bit about your background?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你有五年軟體開發經驗，主要做後端
turns.answer: Sure. I have about five years of experience in software development, mostly on backend systems.
accept: Sure. I have about five years of experience in software development, mostly on backend systems.
I have around five years of experience in software development, mainly backend.
turns.note_zh: 說年資用 I have X years of experience in…，不要說 I have worked X years。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Great. Could you walk me through a project you're proud of?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你帶一個小團隊搬遷了整個計費系統，花了大約八個月
turns.answer: I led a small team that migrated our entire billing system. It took about eight months.
accept: I led a small team that migrated our entire billing system. It took about eight months.
I led a small team to migrate our whole billing system, which took around eight months.
turns.note_zh: lead 的過去式是 led，不是 leaded。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's a big undertaking. What made you interested in this role?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你對他們提到的協作文化特別有興趣
turns.answer: I'm particularly interested in the collaborative culture you described.
accept: I'm particularly interested in the collaborative culture you described.
What interests me most is the collaborative culture you mentioned.
turns.note_zh: 回應面試官前面說過的內容，會顯得你有在聽。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Good to hear. Do you have any questions for me?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問他們這裡典型的一週大概是什麼樣子
turns.answer: Could you walk me through what a typical week looks like here?
accept: Could you walk me through what a typical week looks like here?
What does a typical week look like on this team?
turns.note_zh: 間接問句語序是 what a typical week looks like，不是 what does a typical week look like。

title: 跟主管談期限
setting_zh: 專案進度落後，你必須跟主管談交付時間。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: So, are we still on track to ship everything by the end of the month?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 坦白說技術上做得到，但你對品質沒把握
turns.answer: I want to be upfront with you. It's technically possible, but I'm not confident about the quality.
accept: I want to be upfront with you. It's technically possible, but I'm not confident about the quality.
To be upfront, it's technically possible, but I'm not confident we can do it well.
turns.note_zh: be upfront with someone 是「對某人坦白」，談壞消息時的好開場。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I appreciate the honesty. What are you suggesting?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 提議把期限往後延一週
turns.answer: If we can push the deadline back by one week, I'd feel much better about it.
accept: If we can push the deadline back by one week, I'd feel much better about it.
Could we push the deadline back by a week?
turns.note_zh: push back 是延後；用 If we can… I'd feel… 比直接要求更軟。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: A week is difficult. The client presentation is already scheduled.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 提出替代方案：先交核心功能，其餘後續補上
turns.answer: Alternatively, we could ship the core features on time and follow up with the rest.
accept: Alternatively, we could ship the core features on time and follow up with the rest.
Another option is to ship the core features on time and deliver the rest later.
turns.note_zh: 被拒絕之後馬上給替代方案，是談判裡最有效的一步。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That could work. Put together a list of what makes the first cut and send it to me today.

title: 問路與交通
setting_zh: 你在陌生的城市，想去國家博物館，於是攔下一位路人。

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 禮貌地攔住對方，問怎麼去國家博物館
turns.answer: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the National Museum?
accept: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the National Museum?
Excuse me, how do I get to the National Museum?
turns.note_zh: get to 是「抵達」，問路最常用的動詞。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Sure. It's about a twenty-minute walk, or you can take the subway — two stops on the blue line.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問地鐵站在哪裡
turns.answer: Where is the nearest subway station?
accept: Where is the nearest subway station?
Could you tell me where the nearest subway station is?
turns.note_zh: 注意：直接問句是 Where is…，但用 Could you tell me 開頭時要改成 where … is。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Go straight down this street and turn left at the traffic light. You'll see the entrance.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 確認博物館幾點關門
turns.answer: Great, thanks. Do you know what time the museum closes?
accept: Great, thanks. Do you know what time the museum closes?
Thank you. Do you know when the museum closes?
turns.note_zh: Do you know what time…？比 What time…？更客氣，適合問陌生人。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I think it's six on weekdays. You've got plenty of time.

title: 看醫生
setting_zh: 你因為喉嚨痛和咳嗽來到診所，醫生請你坐下。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Come on in and take a seat. What seems to be the problem?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你喉嚨痛了三天，而且一直咳嗽
turns.answer: I've had a sore throat for three days and I keep coughing.
accept: I've had a sore throat for three days and I keep coughing.
My throat has been sore for three days and I can't stop coughing.
turns.note_zh: 描述症狀持續多久用現在完成式 I've had…for。keep + V-ing 表示一直持續。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Any fever? And have you been taking anything for it?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說沒有發燒，只吃了成藥的咳嗽糖漿
turns.answer: No fever, I've just been taking some over-the-counter cough syrup.
accept: No fever, I've just been taking some over-the-counter cough syrup.
No fever. I've only taken some cough medicine from the pharmacy.
turns.note_zh: over-the-counter 是「不用處方的成藥」，看醫生時很實用的字。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Let me have a look at your throat. Say ah for me. Hmm, it's quite inflamed.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問這需要吃抗生素嗎
turns.answer: Do I need antibiotics for this?
accept: Do I need antibiotics for this?
Will I need to take antibiotics?
turns.note_zh: antibiotics 是抗生素，重音在 -bi-。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Not at this stage. It looks viral, so rest and fluids should do it. Come back if it's not improving in a week.

title: 手機送修
setting_zh: 你的手機螢幕摔破了，拿到維修店。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Hi there, what can I do for you?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你摔到手機，螢幕裂了，想問修理要多少錢
turns.answer: I dropped my phone and cracked the screen. How much would it cost to fix?
accept: I dropped my phone and cracked the screen. How much would it cost to fix?
I cracked my phone screen. How much is it to repair?
turns.note_zh: crack 是裂開；How much would it cost to… 是詢價的委婉句型。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Let's have a look. It's a full screen replacement, I'm afraid. That'll be one eighty.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問要花多久時間
turns.answer: How long will it take?
accept: How long will it take?
How long would that take?
turns.note_zh: 問耗時最簡潔的說法，不用說 How much time。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: If you leave it with us now, it should be ready by five this afternoon.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問裡面的資料會不會不見
turns.answer: Will I lose any of my data?
accept: Will I lose any of my data?
Will my data be affected?
turns.note_zh: lose data 是資料遺失。送修前一定要問的一句。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: No, a screen replacement doesn't touch your data. But it's always worth backing up, just in case.

title: 看房子
setting_zh: 你在看一間出租的公寓，房仲帶你參觀。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: So this is the living room, and the bedroom's just through there. What do you think?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說感覺比照片上大，問租金包含哪些費用
turns.answer: It feels bigger than it looked in the photos. What's included in the rent?
accept: It feels bigger than it looked in the photos. What's included in the rent?
It looks bigger than the pictures. What does the rent include?
turns.note_zh: What's included in the rent? 是租屋必問，指水電網路等是否含在內。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Rent covers water and building maintenance. Electricity and internet are separate.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問押金要幾個月，還有最短要租多久
turns.answer: How much is the deposit, and what's the minimum lease term?
accept: How much is the deposit, and what's the minimum lease term?
How many months' deposit, and how long is the minimum contract?
turns.note_zh: deposit 是押金；lease term 是租期。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Two months' deposit, and we're looking for a one-year minimum.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你想再看一兩間比較，這兩天給答覆
turns.answer: I'd like to see a couple more places before deciding. I'll let you know within a few days.
accept: I'd like to see a couple more places before deciding. I'll let you know within a few days.
I want to look at a few more before I decide. I'll get back to you in a couple of days.
turns.note_zh: 不當場答應但保持禮貌，I'll let you know 是最常用的緩衝說法。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Of course, take your time. Just be aware there's been quite a bit of interest in this one.

title: 跟鄰居抱怨噪音
setting_zh: 樓上鄰居連續幾晚都很吵，你決定去敲門溝通。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Oh, hi. Is everything all right?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 先客氣地說不好意思打擾，但最近晚上聲音有點大
turns.answer: Sorry to bother you, but there's been quite a bit of noise late at night recently.
accept: Sorry to bother you, but there's been quite a bit of noise late at night recently.
Sorry to disturb you, but it's been quite noisy at night lately.
turns.note_zh: 抱怨前先說 Sorry to bother you 可以大幅降低對立感。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Really? I'm so sorry, I had no idea. What kind of noise?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說大概半夜十二點後有搬動家具的聲音
turns.answer: It sounds like furniture being moved, usually after midnight.
accept: It sounds like furniture being moved, usually after midnight.
It sounds like someone moving furniture, mostly after midnight.
turns.note_zh: It sounds like… 是「聽起來像…」，描述不確定的聲音來源時很好用。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Ah, that would be my flatmate. He works nights and gets in around then. I'll have a word with him.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 表示感謝，說你不是想找麻煩，只是想睡好
turns.answer: Thanks, I appreciate it. I'm not trying to make trouble, I just need to sleep.
accept: Thanks, I appreciate it. I'm not trying to make trouble, I just need to sleep.
Thank you. I don't want to cause any problems, I just need to get some sleep.
turns.note_zh: 結尾說明自己的立場，避免對方覺得你在挑釁。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: No, you're right to say something. I'll make sure he keeps it down.

title: 銀行開戶
setting_zh: 你剛到一個新城市，去銀行開戶。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Good morning. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你想開一個活存帳戶
turns.answer: I'd like to open a savings account.
accept: I'd like to open a savings account.
I want to open a savings account, please.
turns.note_zh: savings account 是儲蓄帳戶；支票帳戶是 checking account（美）或 current account（英）。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Certainly. Do you have proof of identity and proof of address with you?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你帶了護照，但問水電帳單可以當地址證明嗎
turns.answer: I have my passport. Would a utility bill work as proof of address?
accept: I have my passport. Would a utility bill work as proof of address?
I've got my passport. Is a utility bill enough for proof of address?
turns.note_zh: utility bill 是水電瓦斯帳單，各國開戶普遍接受的地址證明。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's fine, as long as it's dated within the last three months.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問有沒有月費
turns.answer: Is there a monthly fee for this account?
accept: Is there a monthly fee for this account?
Are there any monthly charges?
turns.note_zh: fee 與 charge 都指費用，銀行文件兩者都會出現。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: No monthly fee as long as you keep a minimum balance of five hundred.

title: 搭計程車
setting_zh: 你在機場外攔到一台計程車。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Where to?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說要去市中心的君悅飯店
turns.answer: The Grand Hotel in the city centre, please.
accept: The Grand Hotel in the city centre, please.
Could you take me to the Grand Hotel downtown?
turns.note_zh: 英式說 city centre，美式說 downtown。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: No problem. Traffic's a bit heavy right now, so it might take forty minutes.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問大概要多少錢
turns.answer: Roughly how much will it be?
accept: Roughly how much will it be?
About how much will the fare be?
turns.note_zh: roughly 是「大約」；車資是 fare 不是 price。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: It's metered, but usually around thirty-five to forty.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問可以刷卡嗎
turns.answer: Do you take cards?
accept: Do you take cards?
Can I pay by card?
turns.note_zh: Do you take…? 是問「收不收某種付款方式」的固定說法。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Yes, card's fine. There's a reader on the back of the seat.

title: 退貨
setting_zh: 你買的鞋子回家試穿後太小，拿回店裡。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Hi, how can I help?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說這雙鞋太小，想換大半號
turns.answer: These shoes are too tight. Could I exchange them for half a size up?
accept: These shoes are too tight. Could I exchange them for half a size up?
These are too small. Can I swap them for the next size up?
turns.note_zh: 鞋子太小說 too tight 比 too small 更精確；half a size up 是大半號。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Sure. Do you have the receipt, and have they been worn outside?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說收據在這裡，只在家裡試穿過
turns.answer: Here's the receipt. I only tried them on indoors.
accept: Here's the receipt. I only tried them on indoors.
I have the receipt here. I only wore them inside the house.
turns.note_zh: try on 是試穿；indoors 是室內。退貨時這個細節很關鍵。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's fine. Let me check if we have your size... I'm afraid we're out of that colour in the larger size.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問可以退錢嗎，還是只能換別的顏色
turns.answer: Could I get a refund instead, or is it exchange only?
accept: Could I get a refund instead, or is it exchange only?
Can I have my money back, or can I only exchange?
turns.note_zh: refund 是退款；exchange 是換貨。兩者政策常不同，要問清楚。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: We can do a full refund back to your card, that's no problem.

title: 績效面談談加薪
setting_zh: 年度績效面談，主管問你有沒有什麼想談的。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That covers the review. Was there anything else you wanted to raise?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你想談談薪資
turns.answer: Yes, I'd like to talk about my compensation.
accept: Yes, I'd like to talk about my compensation.
Yes, I was hoping to discuss my salary.
turns.note_zh: compensation 涵蓋薪資與福利，比 salary 更全面，談判時常用。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: All right. What did you have in mind?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你這一年多接了帶團隊的責任，想討論調整到符合的水準
turns.answer: I've taken on team lead responsibilities this year, and I'd like my salary to reflect that.
accept: I've taken on team lead responsibilities this year, and I'd like my salary to reflect that.
I've taken on more responsibility as team lead, and I think my pay should reflect that.
turns.note_zh: reflect 是「反映」—— 用「薪資反映職責」比直接說「我要加薪」更有說服力。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's a fair point. Do you have a figure in mind?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你查過市場行情，希望調到某個區間
turns.answer: Based on what I've seen in the market, I was hoping for something in the range we discussed for senior roles.
accept: Based on what I've seen in the market, I was hoping for something in the range we discussed for senior roles.
Looking at market rates, I'd be hoping for the senior range.
turns.note_zh: 用市場行情當依據，比講個人需求有力。in the range of 是「在…區間」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I can't commit today, but I'll take it to HR and come back to you within two weeks.

title: 婉拒額外工作
setting_zh: 同事想把一個專案交給你，但你手上已經滿了。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Hey, do you have capacity to take on the reporting project? It'd only be a few days' work.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你手上已經滿了，這週恐怕接不下來
turns.answer: I'm pretty stretched at the moment, so I don't think I could take that on this week.
accept: I'm pretty stretched at the moment, so I don't think I could take that on this week.
My plate's quite full right now, so I couldn't take it on this week.
turns.note_zh: stretched 或 my plate is full 都是「忙不過來」的委婉說法。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Ah, that's a shame. It's fairly time-sensitive.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 提議如果可以等到下週，你可以接；或者你可以先幫忙看方向
turns.answer: If it can wait until next week, I could pick it up then. Otherwise I'm happy to point you in the right direction.
accept: If it can wait until next week, I could pick it up then. Otherwise I'm happy to point you in the right direction.
If it could wait until next week, I'd be able to help. Or I could at least give you some pointers.
turns.note_zh: 拒絕之後給替代方案，是維持合作關係的關鍵。point someone in the right direction 是「指個方向」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Next week might actually work. Let me check with the client and get back to you.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說好，並請他先把需求整理給你
turns.answer: Sounds good. Could you send over the requirements in the meantime?
accept: Sounds good. Could you send over the requirements in the meantime?
That works. Could you send me the requirements beforehand?
turns.note_zh: in the meantime 是「在這期間」，銜接兩件事的實用連接詞。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Will do. Thanks for being flexible about it.

title: 第一次跟客戶通話
setting_zh: 你第一次跟一位新客戶開視訊會議。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Hi, can you hear me okay? I think my connection's a bit unstable.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說聽得很清楚，並自我介紹是這個專案的負責人
turns.answer: I can hear you clearly. I'm the project lead on this, so I'll be your main point of contact.
accept: I can hear you clearly. I'm the project lead on this, so I'll be your main point of contact.
You're coming through clearly. I'm leading this project and will be your main contact.
turns.note_zh: point of contact 是「窗口」，商務往來的固定用語。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Great. So where would you like to start?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 提議先請對方說明目標，再談時程
turns.answer: I'd suggest we start with your goals, and then move on to timelines.
accept: I'd suggest we start with your goals, and then move on to timelines.
Let's begin with your objectives and then talk about timelines.
turns.note_zh: I'd suggest we… 是主持會議時提議流程的得體說法。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Sounds sensible. Our main goal is to cut the processing time in half by the end of the year.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 確認你理解正確：目標是年底前處理時間減半
turns.answer: Just to make sure I've got this right, you want processing time halved by the end of the year.
accept: Just to make sure I've got this right, you want processing time halved by the end of the year.
Let me confirm: the goal is to halve processing time by year end.
turns.note_zh: Just to make sure I've got this right 是複述確認的標準句型，能避免後續誤解。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Exactly. And ideally without adding headcount.

title: 面試：談失敗經驗
setting_zh: 面試官問你一個關於挫折的問題。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Tell me about a time something didn't go to plan. What happened?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你曾經低估一個專案的難度，結果延遲了兩個月
turns.answer: I once underestimated how complex a project was, and we ended up two months late.
accept: I once underestimated how complex a project was, and we ended up two months late.
I underestimated the complexity of a project once and we were two months behind.
turns.note_zh: 談失敗要具體。ended up + 形容詞 是「最後變成…」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: What do you think caused that?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你當時沒有先問清楚需求就開始估時程
turns.answer: I started estimating before I fully understood the requirements.
accept: I started estimating before I fully understood the requirements.
I gave an estimate before I really understood what was needed.
turns.note_zh: 誠實指出自己的問題，比推給別人更能建立信任。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: And what would you do differently now?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你現在會先花時間釐清需求，也會給區間而不是單一日期
turns.answer: Now I take the time to clarify requirements first, and I give a range rather than a single date.
accept: Now I take the time to clarify requirements first, and I give a range rather than a single date.
These days I clarify requirements first and quote a range instead of one fixed date.
turns.note_zh: 這題的重點不是失敗本身，而是你從中改變了什麼 —— 一定要講到具體做法。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's a good answer. It's rare that people give a concrete change like that.

title: 面試：反問公司問題
setting_zh: 面試接近尾聲，面試官問你有沒有問題。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: We're nearly out of time, but do you have any questions for us?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問這個職位最大的挑戰是什麼
turns.answer: What would you say is the biggest challenge in this role?
accept: What would you say is the biggest challenge in this role?
What's the hardest part of this job?
turns.note_zh: 問挑戰比問福利更能展現投入度，也讓你判斷這份工作適不適合。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Probably context switching. The team supports several products, so priorities shift.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問團隊怎麼決定優先順序
turns.answer: How does the team decide what to prioritise?
accept: How does the team decide what to prioritise?
How are priorities decided within the team?
turns.note_zh: 接著對方的回答繼續追問，比問一串預備好的問題更自然。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: We do a planning session every fortnight, and the product lead makes the final call.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問接下來的流程是什麼、大概什麼時候會有消息
turns.answer: What are the next steps, and when might I hear back?
accept: What are the next steps, and when might I hear back?
What happens next, and when should I expect to hear from you?
turns.note_zh: 面試最後一定要問流程與時間，hear back 是「收到回覆」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: We'll be making decisions by the end of next week, so you'll hear from us either way.

title: 跟同事介紹自己
setting_zh: 你今天第一天上班，同事過來打招呼。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Hi! You must be the new starter. I'm Dan, I sit just over there.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 打招呼、說你的名字，說今天第一天
turns.answer: Hi Dan, nice to meet you. I'm Wei, today's my first day.
accept: Hi Dan, nice to meet you. I'm Wei, today's my first day.
Hi Dan, good to meet you. I'm Wei, it's my first day today.
turns.note_zh: first day 前面用 today's 或 it's my，兩種都自然。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Welcome! What team are you joining?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你加入後端團隊，會做 API 相關的工作
turns.answer: I'm joining the backend team, mostly working on the APIs.
accept: I'm joining the backend team, mostly working on the APIs.
I'm on the backend team, mainly working on APIs.
turns.note_zh: join a team 是加入團隊；work on something 是負責某項工作。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Nice, you'll be working closely with Priya then. Have you had the office tour yet?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說還沒，問廚房在哪裡
turns.answer: Not yet. Could you show me where the kitchen is?
accept: Not yet. Could you show me where the kitchen is?
Not yet, actually. Where's the kitchen?
turns.note_zh: 間接問句語序是 where the kitchen is，不是 where is the kitchen。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Course, it's just down the corridor. I'll grab a coffee with you and introduce you to a few people.

title: 寄包裹
setting_zh: 你在郵局要寄一個包裹到國外。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Next, please. What can I do for you?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你要把這個包裹寄到台灣
turns.answer: I'd like to send this parcel to Taiwan.
accept: I'd like to send this parcel to Taiwan.
I need to post this package to Taiwan.
turns.note_zh: 英式常說 parcel、post；美式常說 package、mail。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Sure. Is there anything fragile or any liquid inside?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說裡面是書和衣服，沒有易碎品
turns.answer: Just books and clothes, nothing fragile.
accept: Just books and clothes, nothing fragile.
It's only books and clothing, nothing breakable.
turns.note_zh: fragile 是易碎的，包裹上常見的標示字。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's fine. Standard shipping takes about two weeks, express is five to seven days.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問兩種各要多少錢
turns.answer: How much is each of those?
accept: How much is each of those?
What's the price difference between the two?
turns.note_zh: each of those 指前面提到的兩個選項，避免重複整句。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Standard is twenty-two, express is forty-eight. Both include tracking.

title: 在藥局買成藥
setting_zh: 你感冒了，到藥局想買點藥。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Hi, can I help you find anything?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你喉嚨痛、有點咳嗽，想找不會想睡的藥
turns.answer: I have a sore throat and a bit of a cough. Do you have anything non-drowsy?
accept: I have a sore throat and a bit of a cough. Do you have anything non-drowsy?
I've got a sore throat and a cough. Something that won't make me sleepy?
turns.note_zh: non-drowsy 是「不會想睡的」，藥品包裝常見的標示。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: These lozenges are fine during the day. Are you taking any other medication at the moment?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說沒有，但你對青黴素過敏
turns.answer: No, but I'm allergic to penicillin.
accept: No, but I'm allergic to penicillin.
Nothing else, though I do have a penicillin allergy.
turns.note_zh: be allergic to 後面接過敏原。買藥時一定要主動說。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's fine, there's no penicillin in these. Take one every four hours as needed.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問如果三天後沒好轉該怎麼辦
turns.answer: What should I do if it hasn't improved in three days?
accept: What should I do if it hasn't improved in three days?
And if it's no better after three days?
turns.note_zh: improve 是好轉；問後續處置是就醫問診的好習慣。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: If there's no improvement by then, or if you develop a fever, see your GP.

title: 跟房東報修
setting_zh: 你租的房子熱水器壞了，打電話給房東。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Hello?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你是租客，熱水器從昨天開始沒有熱水
turns.answer: Hi, it's your tenant at flat three. There's been no hot water since yesterday.
accept: Hi, it's your tenant at flat three. There's been no hot water since yesterday.
Hi, this is your tenant. We haven't had hot water since yesterday.
turns.note_zh: tenant 是房客，landlord 是房東。since yesterday 用現在完成式。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Oh dear. Is the boiler making any noise, or showing an error code?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說螢幕上顯示 E1，你試過重開但沒用
turns.answer: It's showing E1 on the display. I tried restarting it but it didn't help.
accept: It's showing E1 on the display. I tried restarting it but it didn't help.
There's an E1 error code. Restarting it made no difference.
turns.note_zh: 先說明已經試過什麼，能省掉對方重複問。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Right, that usually means low pressure. I'll get an engineer out. When are you in?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說平日下午三點後都在，週末整天都可以
turns.answer: I'm in after three on weekdays, and all day at weekends.
accept: I'm in after three on weekdays, and all day at weekends.
Weekdays after three, or any time at the weekend.
turns.note_zh: be in 是「人在家」，跟 be at home 同義但更口語。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I'll aim for Saturday morning then. I'll text you once it's confirmed.

title: 退掉訂閱服務
setting_zh: 你打電話取消一個每月訂閱，客服試著挽留你。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Thanks for holding. How can I help today?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你想取消訂閱
turns.answer: I'd like to cancel my subscription, please.
accept: I'd like to cancel my subscription, please.
I want to cancel my membership.
turns.note_zh: 直接講目的，不要繞圈子，否則對話會被引導到別的地方。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I'm sorry to hear that. May I ask what's prompted the decision?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你最近幾乎沒用到，不值得這個價錢
turns.answer: I've barely used it recently, so it's not worth the cost for me.
accept: I've barely used it recently, so it's not worth the cost for me.
I hardly use it these days, so it doesn't justify the price.
turns.note_zh: barely 是「幾乎沒有」；worth the cost 是「值這個價」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I understand. I can offer you three months at half price if that would help?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 婉拒，並說還是請他們幫你取消
turns.answer: Thanks, but I'd still like to go ahead and cancel.
accept: Thanks, but I'd still like to go ahead and cancel.
I appreciate the offer, but please go ahead and cancel it.
turns.note_zh: go ahead and 是「就這樣做吧」，語氣堅定但不失禮。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: No problem at all. I've processed that, and you'll have access until the end of the current billing period.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 請對方寄一封確認信給你
turns.answer: Could you send me a confirmation email?
accept: Could you send me a confirmation email?
Can I get that confirmed in writing?
turns.note_zh: 取消服務一定要留書面證據，in writing 是「以書面形式」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Already on its way. You should have it within a few minutes.

title: 跟朋友借錢
setting_zh: 你臨時需要一筆錢，開口跟朋友商量。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Hey, you said there was something you wanted to talk about?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說有點不好意思，但想問能不能借一筆錢
turns.answer: This is a bit awkward, but I wanted to ask if I could borrow some money.
accept: This is a bit awkward, but I wanted to ask if I could borrow some money.
It's a bit uncomfortable to ask, but could I borrow some money?
turns.note_zh: 先承認尷尬反而讓對方比較好接話。borrow 是借入。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Oh. How much are we talking about?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說大概五百，下個月發薪就還
turns.answer: Around five hundred. I'd pay you back when I get paid next month.
accept: Around five hundred. I'd pay you back when I get paid next month.
About five hundred, and I could repay you after next month's payday.
turns.note_zh: pay someone back 是還錢。主動說出還款時間很重要。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I can do that. Is everything okay, though? You don't have to tell me.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說車子突然要修，保險不理賠
turns.answer: The car needed unexpected repairs and the insurance won't cover it.
accept: The car needed unexpected repairs and the insurance won't cover it.
My car needed emergency repairs and insurance isn't covering it.
turns.note_zh: cover 在保險語境是「理賠、涵蓋」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's rough. I'll transfer it tonight. And genuinely, don't stress about paying it back immediately.

title: 開會時提出反對意見
setting_zh: 團隊正要決定一個技術方向，你不同意但想好好表達。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: So unless anyone objects, we'll go with rewriting the whole module.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你有不同看法，想先確認你理解得對不對
turns.answer: I see it a bit differently. Can I check I've understood the plan correctly first?
accept: I see it a bit differently. Can I check I've understood the plan correctly first?
I have a different view. Could I first make sure I've understood correctly?
turns.note_zh: 先確認理解再反對，可以避免因為誤會而爭論。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Go ahead.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說如果全部重寫要花三個月，而問題其實集中在一個檔案
turns.answer: A full rewrite would take about three months, but the problems seem concentrated in one file.
accept: A full rewrite would take about three months, but the problems seem concentrated in one file.
Rewriting everything is roughly three months, yet the issues are mostly in a single file.
turns.note_zh: 用具體數字與觀察來支持論點，比說「我覺得不好」有力得多。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's fair. But that file has been patched so many times it's barely readable.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 提議先只重寫那個檔案，兩週後再看要不要繼續
turns.answer: Could we rewrite just that file first and reassess in two weeks?
accept: Could we rewrite just that file first and reassess in two weeks?
What if we start with that file and review in two weeks?
turns.note_zh: 提出可逆的小步驟，比全盤否定對方的提案更容易被接受。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I can live with that. Let's timebox it and see where we are.

title: 跟客戶說明超出範圍
setting_zh: 客戶臨時追加需求，你需要說明這超出原本的合約範圍。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: While you're at it, could you also add a reporting dashboard? Shouldn't be much extra.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說這個做得到，但不在原本的範圍內
turns.answer: That's certainly possible, but it's outside the original scope.
accept: That's certainly possible, but it's outside the original scope.
We can definitely do that, though it wasn't part of the agreed scope.
turns.note_zh: 先肯定可行性再說明限制，比直接說 no 好談。scope 是合約範圍。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Right. How much are we talking, roughly?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說大概要多兩週，你可以先出一份估價
turns.answer: Roughly two additional weeks. I can put together a quote for you.
accept: Roughly two additional weeks. I can put together a quote for you.
About two extra weeks. I'll prepare a quote.
turns.note_zh: quote 是報價；put together 是「整理出、擬出」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: And that wouldn't push back the original delivery date?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說如果要維持原本的交期，就得分成兩階段交付
turns.answer: To keep the original date, we'd need to deliver it in two phases.
accept: To keep the original date, we'd need to deliver it in two phases.
If the original date is fixed, we'd have to split delivery into two phases.
turns.note_zh: 提出「不是不行，但要換一種做法」比單純說不可能更專業。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Two phases works. Send me the quote and I'll get it approved this week.

title: 跟主管回報壞消息
setting_zh: 你發現一個上線後才出現的重大問題，要向主管回報。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: You said it was urgent?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說昨天上線的功能造成部分使用者無法登入
turns.answer: The release yesterday is stopping some users from logging in.
accept: The release yesterday is stopping some users from logging in.
Yesterday's release is preventing some users from signing in.
turns.note_zh: 壞消息先講結論再講細節，不要鋪陳。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: How many users are we talking about?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說大約百分之五，都是用舊版 App 的人
turns.answer: Around five percent, all of them on the older app version.
accept: Around five percent, all of them on the older app version.
About five percent, specifically users on the old app version.
turns.note_zh: 能界定影響範圍，主管才有辦法判斷嚴重程度。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Do we roll back, or can you fix forward?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你建議先回退，修好再重新上線
turns.answer: I'd recommend rolling back first, then re-releasing once it's fixed.
accept: I'd recommend rolling back first, then re-releasing once it's fixed.
My recommendation is to roll back now and re-release after the fix.
turns.note_zh: roll back 是版本回退；fix forward 是直接往前修。給出明確建議而不是丟問題。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Agreed. Roll it back now and let's do a proper post-mortem tomorrow.

title: 視訊會議技術問題
setting_zh: 線上會議進行到一半，對方的聲音斷斷續續。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: ...and so the numbers for Q3 show... hello? Can you still hear me?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你聽得到但聲音斷斷續續，剛剛最後一句沒聽清楚
turns.answer: I can hear you but you're breaking up. I missed the last part.
accept: I can hear you but you're breaking up. I missed the last part.
You're cutting out a bit. I didn't catch the last sentence.
turns.note_zh: break up 或 cut out 都指訊號斷續，視訊會議必備說法。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Sorry, my connection's been flaky all morning. Is it better now?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說好多了，並請對方從第三季的數字再說一次
turns.answer: Much better. Could you go back to the Q3 numbers?
accept: Much better. Could you go back to the Q3 numbers?
That's clearer. Could you repeat the part about Q3?
turns.note_zh: go back to 是「回到剛才的部分」，比 say again 更精確。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Sure. Revenue was up nine percent but margin was flat.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 確認你聽到的是營收成長九趴、利潤率持平
turns.answer: Just to confirm, revenue up nine percent and margin flat?
accept: Just to confirm, revenue up nine percent and margin flat?
So that's nine percent revenue growth with flat margin?
turns.note_zh: 訊號不好時複述數字確認，是很值得養成的習慣。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's right. I'll drop the slides in the chat so you've got them either way.

title: 機場報到與行李
setting_zh: 你在機場櫃檯辦理登機，行李有點超重。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Good morning. Passport, please. Just the one bag to check in?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說是的，一件託運，一件隨身
turns.answer: Yes, one to check in and one carry-on.
accept: Yes, one to check in and one carry-on.
Just one checked bag and this hand luggage.
turns.note_zh: carry-on 是美式的隨身行李，英式說 hand luggage。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's twenty-four kilos, I'm afraid the limit is twenty-three.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問可以把東西移到隨身行李嗎
turns.answer: Could I move something into my carry-on?
accept: Could I move something into my carry-on?
Can I transfer a few things to my hand luggage?
turns.note_zh: 超重時先問能不能自己調整，通常比直接付費划算。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Of course, take your time. There's a bench just there.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 重新秤過之後問靠走道的位子還有嗎
turns.answer: That should do it. Are there any aisle seats left?
accept: That should do it. Are there any aisle seats left?
Hopefully that's under now. Any aisle seats available?
turns.note_zh: That should do it 是「這樣應該就可以了」，處理完事情時的口語。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Twenty-two point eight, perfect. And yes, I can put you in 24C.

title: 在餐廳點餐並詢問食材
setting_zh: 你在一家不熟悉的餐廳點餐，有飲食限制。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Are you ready to order, or would you like a few more minutes?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說想先問一下，海鮮燉飯裡面有沒有奶製品
turns.answer: Could I ask first, does the seafood risotto contain any dairy?
accept: Could I ask first, does the seafood risotto contain any dairy?
Before I order, is there dairy in the seafood risotto?
turns.note_zh: dairy 是奶製品的統稱；contain 是「含有」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: It does, there's butter and parmesan. Is it an allergy or a preference?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說是過敏，問有沒有可以做成無奶的餐點
turns.answer: It's an allergy. Is there anything that can be made without dairy?
accept: It's an allergy. Is there anything that can be made without dairy?
It's an allergy, so are there any dairy-free options?
turns.note_zh: 講明是過敏而非偏好，廚房才會認真處理交叉污染。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: The grilled sea bass can be done without butter, and the tomato pasta is dairy-free as standard.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 點鱸魚，並問配菜是什麼
turns.answer: I'll go with the sea bass. What does it come with?
accept: I'll go with the sea bass. What does it come with?
I'll have the sea bass, please. What are the sides?
turns.note_zh: come with 是「附什麼」；sides 是配菜。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: It comes with new potatoes and green beans. I'll flag the allergy with the kitchen.

title: 問路並確認方向
setting_zh: 你在街上迷路，想找一間書店。

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 禮貌地問對方知不知道 Foyles 書店怎麼走
turns.answer: Excuse me, do you know how to get to Foyles bookshop?
accept: Excuse me, do you know how to get to Foyles bookshop?
Sorry to bother you, do you know the way to Foyles?
turns.note_zh: Do you know…? 開頭比直接問路更客氣。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Foyles? Yes, carry on down here, take the second left, and it's on your right.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 複述確認：一直走、第二個左轉、在右手邊
turns.answer: So straight on, second left, and it's on the right?
accept: So straight on, second left, and it's on the right?
Carry on, second left, then on my right — is that right?
turns.note_zh: 複述一次確認，比事後迷路再問一次省事。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's it. It's about a five-minute walk, you can't miss it, it's a big blue sign.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 道謝並問附近有沒有咖啡店
turns.answer: Thanks so much. Is there a coffee shop nearby too?
accept: Thanks so much. Is there a coffee shop nearby too?
Thank you. Any coffee shops around there?
turns.note_zh: nearby 是「附近」，比 near here 精簡。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: There's one right next door, actually. Same building.

title: 面試：談離職原因
setting_zh: 面試官問你為什麼想離開現在的公司。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: So what's making you look to move on from your current role?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你在那裡學了很多，但已經沒有成長空間了
turns.answer: I've learned a lot there, but I've reached a point where there isn't much room to grow.
accept: I've learned a lot there, but I've reached a point where there isn't much room to grow.
It's been a great learning experience, but there's limited room for growth now.
turns.note_zh: 先肯定現職再說明原因，避免給人愛抱怨的印象。room to grow 是成長空間。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Have you raised that internally?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說有，但團隊規模小，短期內沒有相應的職缺
turns.answer: I have, but the team is small and there isn't a suitable role available in the near term.
accept: I have, but the team is small and there isn't a suitable role available in the near term.
Yes, but it's a small team and no suitable position is opening up soon.
turns.note_zh: 說明你已經先嘗試內部解決，顯示你不是遇到事情就跳槽。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's understandable. What would make this role different?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說這裡的產品規模更大，你想累積那種經驗
turns.answer: The scale here is much larger, and that's the kind of experience I want to build.
accept: The scale here is much larger, and that's the kind of experience I want to build.
This product operates at a much bigger scale, which is exactly what I want to learn.
turns.note_zh: 把離職原因連結到「這家公司能給什麼」，比單純抱怨舊東家有說服力。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Good answer. Scale is definitely the thing that would stretch you here.

title: 面試：技術問題答不出來
setting_zh: 面試官問了一個你不熟悉的技術問題。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: How would you approach optimising a query that's scanning millions of rows?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 坦白說你在這方面經驗有限，但可以說說你會怎麼著手
turns.answer: I'll be honest, my experience here is limited, but I can talk through how I'd approach it.
accept: I'll be honest, my experience here is limited, but I can talk through how I'd approach it.
I haven't done much of this, but let me explain how I'd start.
turns.note_zh: 承認不熟但展示思路，遠比硬掰或直接說不會好。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Please do, that's what I'm interested in.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你會先看執行計畫，找出哪一步最花時間
turns.answer: I'd start by looking at the execution plan to see which step is most expensive.
accept: I'd start by looking at the execution plan to see which step is most expensive.
First I'd check the query plan to find the slowest step.
turns.note_zh: expensive 在效能討論裡指「耗費資源」，不是價格貴。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Good. And if it turned out to be a missing index?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說會加索引，但也要考慮寫入變慢的代價
turns.answer: I'd add one, but I'd also weigh up the cost to write performance.
accept: I'd add one, but I'd also weigh up the cost to write performance.
Add an index, though it would need balancing against slower writes.
turns.note_zh: weigh up 是權衡；能主動指出取捨代表你想過實務問題。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's exactly the trade-off I wanted you to mention. Thanks.

title: 跟同事討論分工
setting_zh: 新專案開始，你跟同事討論怎麼分工。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: So how do you want to split this up?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 提議你做後端，對方做前端，介面規格一起先定好
turns.answer: How about I take the backend and you take the frontend, and we agree the interface together first?
accept: How about I take the backend and you take the frontend, and we agree the interface together first?
I could do backend, you do frontend, and we define the interface together upfront.
turns.note_zh: How about + 子句 是提議的輕鬆句型。upfront 是「一開始就」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Works for me. Should we write the API contract before either of us starts?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 同意，並說這樣兩邊可以同時進行
turns.answer: Yes, that way we can work in parallel.
accept: Yes, that way we can work in parallel.
Agreed, then we're not blocking each other.
turns.note_zh: work in parallel 是同時進行；block someone 是擋住別人的進度。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Great. I'll draft it this afternoon and share it with you.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你會在明天中午前給回饋
turns.answer: I'll get you comments by midday tomorrow.
accept: I'll get you comments by midday tomorrow.
I'll review it and comment before noon tomorrow.
turns.note_zh: 主動承諾具體時間，協作起來對方比較好安排。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Perfect. Then we can both start properly on Thursday.

title: 郵局寄掛號
setting_zh: 你要寄一份重要文件，需要掛號。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Next please. What can I do for you?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你要用掛號寄這份文件
turns.answer: I'd like to send this by recorded delivery, please.
accept: I'd like to send this by recorded delivery, please.
Could I send this as registered post?
turns.note_zh: 英式 recorded delivery，美式 certified mail，都是可追蹤的掛號。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Certainly. Does it need to arrive by a particular date?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說必須在星期五之前送到
turns.answer: It needs to get there before Friday.
accept: It needs to get there before Friday.
It has to arrive by Friday at the latest.
turns.note_zh: at the latest 是「最晚」，強調期限時很好用。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Next-day guaranteed would cover that. It's eight fifty.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說可以，並問怎麼追蹤
turns.answer: That's fine. How do I track it?
accept: That's fine. How do I track it?
Sounds good. How can I track the delivery?
turns.note_zh: track 是追蹤包裹；tracking number 是查詢編號。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: There's a reference on your receipt. Just enter that on our website.

title: 跟教練討論訓練計畫
setting_zh: 你第一次到健身房，跟教練討論目標。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: So what are you hoping to get out of this?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你主要想改善體力，不是想練肌肉
turns.answer: Mainly I want to build up my stamina rather than bulk up.
accept: Mainly I want to build up my stamina rather than bulk up.
I'm more interested in fitness than building muscle.
turns.note_zh: stamina 是耐力；bulk up 是增肌，兩個目標的訓練方式差很多。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Good to know. How many days a week can you realistically commit to?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說平日大概三次，每次一小時
turns.answer: Realistically three times a week, about an hour each time.
accept: Realistically three times a week, about an hour each time.
Probably three sessions a week, an hour each.
turns.note_zh: realistically 是「實際上做得到的」，講計畫時比 ideally 誠實。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's plenty. Any injuries or conditions I should know about?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你左邊膝蓋以前受過傷，蹲的時候會痛
turns.answer: I injured my left knee a while back, and it hurts when I squat.
accept: I injured my left knee a while back, and it hurts when I squat.
I had a left knee injury before, and squatting still hurts.
turns.note_zh: a while back 是「之前一段時間」；受傷史一定要主動說。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Right, we'll avoid deep squats and work on that gradually. Let's start light.

title: 孩子學校老師面談
setting_zh: 你參加孩子的家長會，跟老師談。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Thanks for coming in. Overall she's doing well, particularly in maths.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說很高興聽到，但你擔心她的閱讀
turns.answer: That's good to hear. I'm a bit concerned about her reading, though.
accept: That's good to hear. I'm a bit concerned about her reading, though.
Glad to hear it. I do worry about her reading though.
turns.note_zh: be concerned about 比 worry about 冷靜一點，適合正式場合。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: You're right that it's her weaker area. She's about six months behind where I'd expect.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問在家裡可以怎麼幫她
turns.answer: What can we do at home to support her?
accept: What can we do at home to support her?
How can we help her at home?
turns.note_zh: support 在教育語境是「協助、支持」，比 help 正式。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Twenty minutes of reading together every day makes a big difference. Let her choose the book.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問要不要考慮額外的補救教學
turns.answer: Would it be worth arranging some extra support as well?
accept: Would it be worth arranging some extra support as well?
Should we consider additional tutoring too?
turns.note_zh: Would it be worth…? 是徵詢建議時很得體的句型。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Let's try the daily reading first and review at the end of term.

title: 跟客服爭取退款
setting_zh: 你買的線上課程內容跟描述不符，想申請退款。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I can see your order here. What seems to be the issue?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說課程內容跟網頁上寫的不一樣，缺少實作單元
turns.answer: The course doesn't match the description. The practical modules that were advertised aren't there.
accept: The course doesn't match the description. The practical modules that were advertised aren't there.
The content differs from what was advertised. The hands-on modules are missing.
turns.note_zh: doesn't match the description 是消費爭議的關鍵句，advertised 是「廣告上宣稱的」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I see. Unfortunately our policy is no refunds after fourteen days.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你理解政策，但這是內容與描述不符，不是你改變心意
turns.answer: I understand the policy, but this isn't a change of mind — the product isn't as described.
accept: I understand the policy, but this isn't a change of mind — the product isn't as described.
I appreciate the policy, but the issue is misdescription, not buyer's remorse.
turns.note_zh: 區分「反悔」與「貨不對版」，是爭取退款最有力的角度。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Let me check with my supervisor. Could you point to which modules are missing?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你已經把網頁截圖和課程目錄寄過去了
turns.answer: I've already emailed screenshots of the sales page alongside the actual syllabus.
accept: I've already emailed screenshots of the sales page alongside the actual syllabus.
I sent over screenshots comparing the advert with the real course outline.
turns.note_zh: alongside 是「與…並列」；提供對照證據能大幅提高成功率。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's very helpful. Given the discrepancy, I can authorise a full refund.

title: 第一次帶新人
setting_zh: 你負責帶一位新進同事，第一次一對一。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Thanks for taking the time. I'm still trying to work out where to start.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說第一週不用急著產出，先熟悉環境就好
turns.answer: Don't worry about output in the first week. Just focus on getting familiar with things.
accept: Don't worry about output in the first week. Just focus on getting familiar with things.
There's no pressure to deliver in week one. Focus on finding your feet.
turns.note_zh: find your feet 是「進入狀況」，帶新人時很常說。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That helps. Is there anything I should read first?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 建議先看架構文件，其他等實際碰到再查
turns.answer: Start with the architecture doc. The rest you can look up when you actually hit it.
accept: Start with the architecture doc. The rest you can look up when you actually hit it.
Read the architecture overview first; look up the rest as you need it.
turns.note_zh: look something up 是查資料；hit 在這裡是「實際遇到」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Got it. And if I get stuck, how long should I try before asking?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說卡超過三十分鐘就直接問，不要自己撐
turns.answer: If you're stuck for more than thirty minutes, just ask. Don't struggle on alone.
accept: If you're stuck for more than thirty minutes, just ask. Don't struggle on alone.
Anything over thirty minutes stuck, come and ask. No need to suffer through it.
turns.note_zh: 給出明確的時間界線，新人才不會不敢問或問太快。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's really useful, thanks. I'll take you up on that.

title: 專案回顧會議
setting_zh: 專案結束後的檢討會議，主持人請大家發言。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Let's start with what went well. Anyone want to kick off?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說每日站會很有效，問題都能很快浮現
turns.answer: The daily standups worked well. Problems surfaced much earlier than usual.
accept: The daily standups worked well. Problems surfaced much earlier than usual.
Standups were effective — issues came up early rather than late.
turns.note_zh: surface 當動詞是「浮現」，講問題被發現時很貼切。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Good. And what didn't go so well?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說需求變動太頻繁，而且沒有正式的記錄
turns.answer: Requirements changed too often, and the changes weren't formally recorded.
accept: Requirements changed too often, and the changes weren't formally recorded.
The requirements kept shifting and there was no formal record of the changes.
turns.note_zh: 檢討時對事不對人，講「流程沒有記錄」而不是「某某人一直改」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That came up from others too. What would you change next time?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 提議任何需求變動都要寫進單子並重新估時
turns.answer: Any change should go into a ticket and trigger a re-estimate.
accept: Any change should go into a ticket and trigger a re-estimate.
Changes should be ticketed and the estimate revisited each time.
turns.note_zh: trigger 在這裡是「觸發某個流程」；提出可執行的做法比抱怨有用。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I'll write that up as an action. Thanks, that's concrete.

title: 跟廠商討價還價
setting_zh: 你在跟一家供應商談年度合約價格。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: So the quote comes to forty-eight thousand for the year.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說這超出你們的預算不少
turns.answer: That's some way above the budget we've set aside.
accept: That's some way above the budget we've set aside.
That's considerably more than we've budgeted for.
turns.note_zh: some way above 是「高出不少」，比 too expensive 專業。set aside 是預留。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I appreciate that. What figure were you working towards?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說四萬左右，並問如果簽兩年有沒有空間
turns.answer: Around forty. Is there any flexibility if we commit to two years?
accept: Around forty. Is there any flexibility if we commit to two years?
Closer to forty. Would a two-year commitment change anything?
turns.note_zh: flexibility 是「有沒有談的空間」；用長約換折扣是常見手法。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: A two-year deal I could probably do at forty-three. Not forty, I'm afraid.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說四十三可以考慮，但希望包含教育訓練
turns.answer: Forty-three could work if training is included.
accept: Forty-three could work if training is included.
I could accept forty-three provided training comes with it.
turns.note_zh: 價格談不下來就談附加價值，這是談判的基本功。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Two training days included. Let's shake on that and I'll draft the contract.

title: 訂租車
setting_zh: 你在租車櫃檯辦理取車。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Morning. Do you have your booking reference and driving licence?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說都帶了，並確認保險是不是已經含在裡面
turns.answer: Yes, both here. Can I check whether insurance is already included?
accept: Yes, both here. Can I check whether insurance is already included?
Here you go. Is the insurance included in the booking?
turns.note_zh: 租車最容易吃虧的就是保險，一定要當場問清楚。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Basic cover is included, but the excess is twelve hundred. You can reduce that for fifteen a day.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說先不用，並問油箱的規則是什麼
turns.answer: I'll leave it, thanks. What's the fuel policy?
accept: I'll leave it, thanks. What's the fuel policy?
No thanks. How does the fuel policy work?
turns.note_zh: fuel policy 是油箱規則，full-to-full 是滿油取車滿油還車。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Full to full. Bring it back with a full tank or we charge at our own rate.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問還車晚一點會怎麼樣
turns.answer: What happens if I return it slightly late?
accept: What happens if I return it slightly late?
Is there a grace period for returning it late?
turns.note_zh: grace period 是寬限時間，租車、繳費都會用到。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: There's a thirty-minute grace period, after that it's charged as an extra day.

title: 在國外看急診
setting_zh: 你在旅途中扭傷腳踝，到急診室掛號。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Take a seat. Can you tell me what happened?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你大概一小時前走樓梯時扭到右腳踝
turns.answer: I twisted my right ankle on some stairs about an hour ago.
accept: I twisted my right ankle on some stairs about an hour ago.
I rolled my right ankle going down stairs roughly an hour ago.
turns.note_zh: twist an ankle 是扭到腳踝；美式口語也說 roll an ankle。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Can you put any weight on it?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說可以站但很痛，而且腫起來了
turns.answer: I can stand, but it's very painful and it's swollen.
accept: I can stand, but it's very painful and it's swollen.
I can put some weight on it, but it hurts a lot and there's swelling.
turns.note_zh: swollen 是腫脹的形容詞，名詞是 swelling。put weight on 是「用力踩」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: We'll need an X-ray to rule out a fracture. Do you have travel insurance?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說有，保單號碼在手機裡，問要不要現在提供
turns.answer: Yes, I have the policy number on my phone. Do you need it now?
accept: Yes, I have the policy number on my phone. Do you need it now?
I do — the policy number's on my phone. Shall I give it to you now?
turns.note_zh: policy number 是保單號碼；出國前務必存在手機裡。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Please, and any emergency contact number as well. Then we'll get you booked in for the X-ray.

title: 面試：談團隊衝突
setting_zh: 面試官問你怎麼處理團隊裡的意見不合。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a colleague. How did you handle it?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你曾經跟同事對測試策略有不同看法
turns.answer: A colleague and I disagreed about our testing strategy.
accept: A colleague and I disagreed about our testing strategy.
I had a disagreement with a teammate over how we should approach testing.
turns.note_zh: 先講清楚爭議是「什麼事」，不要一開始就講人。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: What was the substance of the disagreement?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說他想要完整的端對端測試，你認為單元測試投報率更高
turns.answer: He wanted full end-to-end coverage, and I thought unit tests gave better value for the effort.
accept: He wanted full end-to-end coverage, and I thought unit tests gave better value for the effort.
He preferred end-to-end tests; I felt unit tests were a better return on effort.
turns.note_zh: value for the effort 是投報率的口語說法。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: And how was it resolved?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你們挑一個模組兩種都試，用數據決定
turns.answer: We picked one module, tried both approaches, and let the data decide.
accept: We picked one module, tried both approaches, and let the data decide.
We trialled both on a single module and used the results to decide.
turns.note_zh: let the data decide 是用證據取代爭辯，面試官很喜歡這種答案。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's a mature way to handle it. What did the data show, out of curiosity?

title: 面試：談加班文化
setting_zh: 面試進入反問階段，你想了解工作與生活的平衡。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Anything else you'd like to know?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問團隊平常的工作時間大概是什麼樣子
turns.answer: Could you tell me what the typical working hours look like for the team?
accept: Could you tell me what the typical working hours look like for the team?
What do working hours usually look like here?
turns.note_zh: 用 typical 而非 how much overtime，語氣比較中性，不像在防備。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Most people are nine to six. It gets busier close to releases, I won't pretend otherwise.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問那種比較忙的期間大概多久發生一次
turns.answer: How often do those busier periods come around?
accept: How often do those busier periods come around?
And how frequently does that happen?
turns.note_zh: come around 是「週期性出現」，追問頻率才知道那是常態還是偶爾。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Roughly every six weeks, and usually just the final few days.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說這聽起來合理，並問那段期間之後有沒有調整時間
turns.answer: That sounds reasonable. Is there any time off in lieu afterwards?
accept: That sounds reasonable. Is there any time off in lieu afterwards?
That seems fair. Do people take time back afterwards?
turns.note_zh: time off in lieu（TOIL）是加班後的補休，英國職場常見說法。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: We're fairly relaxed about people taking a day back the week after. It's not formally tracked.

title: 跟同事約午餐
setting_zh: 你想約同事一起吃午餐。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Morning! You look like you need a coffee.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 笑著同意，並問對方中午有沒有空一起吃飯
turns.answer: Definitely. Are you free for lunch later?
accept: Definitely. Are you free for lunch later?
I really do. Fancy grabbing lunch later?
turns.note_zh: Fancy + V-ing 是英式的邀約說法，很自然。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I've got a call at twelve thirty, but I could do one o'clock?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說一點可以，問想吃什麼
turns.answer: One works for me. Anywhere you fancy?
accept: One works for me. Anywhere you fancy?
One o'clock's fine. Where do you fancy going?
turns.note_zh: That works for me 是同意安排；fancy 當動詞是「想要」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: There's a new noodle place two streets over. Supposed to be good.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說聽起來不錯，約在一樓大廳碰面
turns.answer: Sounds good. Shall we meet in the lobby?
accept: Sounds good. Shall we meet in the lobby?
Great, let's meet downstairs in the lobby.
turns.note_zh: Shall we…? 是提議一起做某事的英式說法。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: See you there at one.

title: 投訴飯店房間問題
setting_zh: 你入住後發現房間有問題，到櫃檯反映。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Good evening, how can I help?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你住 512 房，冷氣好像不會冷
turns.answer: I'm in room five one two, and the air conditioning doesn't seem to be cooling.
accept: I'm in room five one two, and the air conditioning doesn't seem to be cooling.
Room five twelve — the air con isn't cooling properly.
turns.note_zh: doesn't seem to be 語氣比 is broken 委婉，留了對方解釋的空間。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I'm sorry about that. Have you tried adjusting it on the wall panel?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說試過了，設到最低還是沒有變化
turns.answer: I have — I set it to the lowest and nothing changed.
accept: I have — I set it to the lowest and nothing changed.
Yes, I turned it all the way down but it made no difference.
turns.note_zh: 先講已經試過什麼，可以避免對方再叫你做一次。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I'll send maintenance up. If they can't fix it we'll move you.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說如果要換房，希望是同樣安靜的樓層
turns.answer: If we do move, could it be on a similarly quiet floor?
accept: If we do move, could it be on a similarly quiet floor?
If you move us, I'd prefer a similarly quiet floor.
turns.note_zh: 先提出條件，比換完房才抱怨有效率。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Noted. I'll make sure it's away from the lifts and the road.

title: 換手機門號方案
setting_zh: 你到電信門市想換一個比較便宜的方案。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Hi there, what can I help with today?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你想看看有沒有比現在便宜的方案
turns.answer: I'm looking to switch to a cheaper plan than the one I'm on.
accept: I'm looking to switch to a cheaper plan than the one I'm on.
I'd like to move to a cheaper tariff than my current one.
turns.note_zh: the one I'm on 指目前的方案；英式也說 tariff。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Sure. How much data do you actually use each month?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說大概十 GB，因為大部分時間都連 Wi-Fi
turns.answer: About ten gigabytes, since I'm on Wi-Fi most of the time.
accept: About ten gigabytes, since I'm on Wi-Fi most of the time.
Roughly ten gigs — I'm usually connected to Wi-Fi.
turns.note_zh: gigs 是 gigabytes 的口語簡稱。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Then the fifteen pound plan would suit you. Twenty gigabytes, no contract.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問可以保留原本的號碼嗎
turns.answer: Can I keep my current number?
accept: Can I keep my current number?
Would I be able to keep the same number?
turns.note_zh: 換電信保留門號叫 number porting，日常說 keep my number 就好。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Absolutely, we'll port it over. It usually takes one working day.

title: 跟朋友解釋遲到
setting_zh: 你比約定時間晚了二十分鐘才到。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: There you are! I was starting to think you'd forgotten.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 道歉，說捷運誤點
turns.answer: I'm so sorry, the train was delayed.
accept: I'm so sorry, the train was delayed.
Sorry I'm late — the train got held up.
turns.note_zh: be held up 是「被耽擱」，比 delayed 口語一點。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: No worries, I've been people-watching. Did you get my message?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說沒看到，手機快沒電了
turns.answer: I didn't see it, my phone's nearly dead.
accept: I didn't see it, my phone's nearly dead.
No, sorry — my battery's about to die.
turns.note_zh: phone is dead 是手機沒電；nearly dead 是快沒電。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Ah, that explains it. I said I'd grab a table inside.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說謝謝，並問他點了沒
turns.answer: Thanks for waiting. Have you ordered yet?
accept: Thanks for waiting. Have you ordered yet?
Sorry again — have you already ordered?
turns.note_zh: Thanks for waiting 比一直道歉好，把焦點轉回正事。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Just drinks so far. Let's have a proper look at the menu.

title: 詢問托嬰中心
setting_zh: 你參觀一間托嬰中心，跟負責人詢問細節。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: So that's the main room. Do you have any questions?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問老師跟孩子的比例是多少
turns.answer: What's the staff to child ratio?
accept: What's the staff to child ratio?
How many children per member of staff?
turns.note_zh: staff to child ratio 是師生比，選托育機構的關鍵指標。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: One to three for under-twos, one to four above that.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問如果孩子生病你們怎麼處理
turns.answer: What's the procedure if a child becomes unwell?
accept: What's the procedure if a child becomes unwell?
How do you handle it if a child gets sick?
turns.note_zh: procedure 是既定流程，問機構制度時比 what do you do 精確。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: We call the parent straight away and isolate them comfortably until someone arrives.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問有沒有等候名單，以及最快什麼時候有位子
turns.answer: Is there a waiting list, and when's the earliest a place might come up?
accept: Is there a waiting list, and when's the earliest a place might come up?
Do you have a waiting list? When could a space become available?
turns.note_zh: a place comes up 是「有名額釋出」，英式常用。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: There is, but we usually have movement in September. I'd put your name down now.

title: 跟主管請調部門
setting_zh: 你想轉到另一個團隊，跟主管開口。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: You said you wanted a chat about something?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你想談轉到平台團隊的可能性
turns.answer: I wanted to talk about the possibility of moving to the platform team.
accept: I wanted to talk about the possibility of moving to the platform team.
I'd like to discuss transferring to the platform team.
turns.note_zh: 用 the possibility of 開場，語氣比直接說「我要調走」軟。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Right. Is there something here that's not working for you?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說不是，這裡很好，只是你想做更底層的東西
turns.answer: Not at all, I've enjoyed it here. I'm just drawn to lower-level work.
accept: Not at all, I've enjoyed it here. I'm just drawn to lower-level work.
Nothing's wrong — I'm simply more interested in lower-level systems.
turns.note_zh: be drawn to 是「被吸引」，說明動機而不是抱怨現況。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I'd be sorry to lose you, but I won't stand in your way. Have you spoken to them?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說還沒，想先跟他確認過再談
turns.answer: Not yet — I wanted to speak to you first.
accept: Not yet — I wanted to speak to you first.
I haven't, I thought I should raise it with you before anything else.
turns.note_zh: 先告知主管再去談，是職場上很重要的分寸。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I appreciate that. Let me sound out their lead and we'll see what's possible.

title: 處理同事之間的誤會
setting_zh: 你發現同事似乎誤會了你在會議上說的話。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Have you got a minute? I felt a bit blindsided in that meeting.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說當然，並說你想聽聽他的感受
turns.answer: Of course. I'd like to hear how it came across from your side.
accept: Of course. I'd like to hear how it came across from your side.
Sure. Tell me how it felt from where you were sitting.
turns.note_zh: come across 是「給人的感覺」，先聽再解釋比較不會越描越黑。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: It sounded like you were saying the delay was down to my team.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說那不是你的意思，你是在講流程沒有把關
turns.answer: That wasn't my intention. I was talking about the process, not your team.
accept: That wasn't my intention. I was talking about the process, not your team.
I didn't mean it that way — my point was about the process itself.
turns.note_zh: That wasn't my intention 承認對方的感受，但也澄清原意。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Okay. I think a few people in the room read it the way I did, though.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說既然這樣，你會在下次會議上把話講清楚
turns.answer: In that case I'll clarify it at the next meeting.
accept: In that case I'll clarify it at the next meeting.
If that's how it landed, I'll set it straight next time.
turns.note_zh: how it landed 是「話被接收成什麼樣」；set it straight 是把話講清楚。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That'd mean a lot, thanks. And sorry for coming in hot just now.

title: 申請信用卡
setting_zh: 你在銀行詢問信用卡的申辦條件。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: So you're interested in the travel card?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說是的，並問國外刷卡有沒有手續費
turns.answer: Yes. Are there any fees for spending abroad?
accept: Yes. Are there any fees for spending abroad?
That's right. What are the foreign transaction fees?
turns.note_zh: foreign transaction fee 是海外交易手續費，旅遊卡的關鍵條件。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: No transaction fees, and we use the interbank exchange rate.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問年費多少
turns.answer: What's the annual fee?
accept: What's the annual fee?
Is there an annual charge?
turns.note_zh: annual fee 是年費；免年費說 no annual fee。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Ninety-five a year, though it's waived for the first twelve months.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問申請大概要多久會知道結果
turns.answer: How long does it take to get a decision?
accept: How long does it take to get a decision?
When would I hear back about the application?
turns.note_zh: get a decision 是「知道核卡結果」；waive 是免除費用。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Usually instant, occasionally a couple of days if we need extra checks.

title: 在市場殺價
setting_zh: 你在觀光市場看上一件手工圍巾。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Very good quality, handmade. For you, eighty.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說有點超出預算，問買兩條有沒有折扣
turns.answer: That's a bit more than I wanted to spend. Any discount if I take two?
accept: That's a bit more than I wanted to spend. Any discount if I take two?
It's above my budget. Would you do a deal for two?
turns.note_zh: do a deal 是談價；用「買多」爭取折扣比直接砍價自然。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Two for one forty. That's already a good price, my friend.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說一百二你就買兩條
turns.answer: I'll take two at one twenty.
accept: I'll take two at one twenty.
Would you do one twenty for both?
turns.note_zh: 直接說出你的價格並表明會買，比含糊地說 too expensive 有效。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: One thirty. Final price, really.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說成交，但問可以幫忙分開包裝嗎
turns.answer: Deal. Could you wrap them separately?
accept: Deal. Could you wrap them separately?
Okay, I'll take them. Can you wrap them separately, please?
turns.note_zh: Deal 是成交的口語；separately 是分開，送禮時很實用。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Of course. Two bags, coming up.

title: 面試：談自己的缺點
setting_zh: 面試官問你最需要改進的地方。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: What would you say is your biggest area for development?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你以前太晚才把問題講出來
turns.answer: I used to leave it too long before flagging problems.
accept: I used to leave it too long before flagging problems.
In the past I waited too long to raise issues.
turns.note_zh: flag a problem 是把問題提出來。用 used to 表示這是過去的狀態。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: What was behind that, do you think?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你當時想先自己解決，怕看起來像做不好
turns.answer: I wanted to solve it myself first, and I worried it would look like I couldn't cope.
accept: I wanted to solve it myself first, and I worried it would look like I couldn't cope.
I tried to fix things alone because I didn't want to seem incapable.
turns.note_zh: cope 是「應付得來」；誠實說出動機比空泛的缺點有說服力。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: And what changed?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說現在你會設一個時間點，超過就一定回報
turns.answer: Now I set myself a deadline — if I'm still stuck by then, I escalate.
accept: Now I set myself a deadline — if I'm still stuck by then, I escalate.
These days I give myself a time limit, and if it's not resolved I raise it.
turns.note_zh: escalate 是往上呈報。給出具體機制，這題才算答完整。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's a practical fix. A lot of people describe the problem but not the solution.

title: 面試：被問為什麼空窗
setting_zh: 面試官注意到你履歷上有一段空白。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I notice there's a break here between your last two roles.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說是的，你休息了八個月照顧家人
turns.answer: Yes, I took eight months out to care for a family member.
accept: Yes, I took eight months out to care for a family member.
That's right, I had eight months away to look after a relative.
turns.note_zh: take time out 是暫時離開職場；直接說明比迴避好。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I'm sorry to hear that. Did you keep up with the field at all?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說有，你完成了兩張證照，也接了一些接案工作
turns.answer: I did — I completed two certifications and took on some freelance work.
accept: I did — I completed two certifications and took on some freelance work.
Yes, I finished two certifications and did a bit of freelancing.
turns.note_zh: 說明空窗期做了什麼，比解釋為什麼空窗更重要。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's reassuring. And the situation now?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說已經穩定了，你可以全職投入
turns.answer: It's settled now, so I'm in a position to commit fully.
accept: It's settled now, so I'm in a position to commit fully.
Things have stabilised, so I can commit full-time.
turns.note_zh: be in a position to 是「有條件做某事」，比 I can 正式且有份量。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Thanks for being straightforward about it. That's all I needed to know.

title: 跟房仲談租金
setting_zh: 你想租一間公寓，但希望房租能談。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: So what did you think? The landlord's keen to let it quickly.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你喜歡，但租金比你的預算高一些
turns.answer: I like it, but the rent is a little above my budget.
accept: I like it, but the rent is a little above my budget.
I'm interested, though it's slightly over what I'd budgeted.
turns.note_zh: a little above 語氣溫和，留下談的空間。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: What were you thinking?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說如果願意簽兩年，你希望降五十
turns.answer: If I signed for two years, would the landlord consider fifty less?
accept: If I signed for two years, would the landlord consider fifty less?
Would fifty off be possible for a two-year contract?
turns.note_zh: 用長約換折扣；問 would they consider 比直接開價客氣。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I can put it to them. They did say a longer let would suit them.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說也請他確認可不可以養貓
turns.answer: Could you also check whether cats are allowed?
accept: Could you also check whether cats are allowed?
And could you ask if pets are permitted?
turns.note_zh: 一次把條件問完，不要分好幾輪，這樣談起來比較有效率。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I'll ask both and come back to you by tomorrow afternoon.

title: 線上購物客服
setting_zh: 你網購的商品送錯尺寸，跟線上客服對話。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Hi, thanks for getting in touch. How can I help?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你訂的是 M 號，收到的是 S 號
turns.answer: I ordered a medium but received a small.
accept: I ordered a medium but received a small.
My order was for a medium, but a small arrived.
turns.note_zh: 下單說 ordered，收到說 received，兩個動詞要分清楚。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Sorry about that. Could you confirm the order number?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 給訂單編號，並問可以直接換貨嗎
turns.answer: It's 4-4-8-2-1-7. Can you send the right size directly?
accept: It's 4-4-8-2-1-7. Can you send the right size directly?
Order 448217. Could you just ship the correct size?
turns.note_zh: 念數字時逐位念比較不會聽錯。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I can do that. We'll email you a prepaid label to send the small back.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問要先寄回才會出貨，還是可以同時處理
turns.answer: Do I need to return it first, or will you ship at the same time?
accept: Do I need to return it first, or will you ship at the same time?
Does the replacement wait until you receive the return?
turns.note_zh: 問清楚順序，才知道要等多久。prepaid label 是預付運費的退貨標籤。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: We'll send the replacement today, no need to wait for the return.

title: 跟同事道歉
setting_zh: 你昨天在壓力下對同事說話太衝，今天想道歉。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Morning. Everything alright?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你想為昨天說話的方式道歉
turns.answer: I wanted to apologise for how I spoke to you yesterday.
accept: I wanted to apologise for how I spoke to you yesterday.
I owe you an apology for the way I spoke yesterday.
turns.note_zh: 為「說話的方式」道歉比為「說的內容」道歉更精準，也更誠懇。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Honestly, I could tell you were under pressure.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說壓力大不是理由，你不該用那種語氣
turns.answer: That's not an excuse, though. I shouldn't have taken that tone.
accept: That's not an excuse, though. I shouldn't have taken that tone.
Being stressed isn't an excuse — my tone was out of order.
turns.note_zh: 不要用壓力當藉口，這句話能讓道歉聽起來是真的。take a tone 是用某種語氣。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I appreciate you saying that. It's fine, really.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說謝謝，並提議下次進度太趕時早點一起討論
turns.answer: Thanks. Next time things get tight, let's talk it through earlier.
accept: Thanks. Next time things get tight, let's talk it through earlier.
I appreciate it. Let's flag it sooner next time things get tight.
turns.note_zh: 道歉後提出改善做法，才不會下次又重演。things get tight 是進度或資源吃緊。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Agreed. Let's not let it build up like that again.

title: 詢問語言課程
setting_zh: 你到語言中心詢問英語課程。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Have you studied with us before, or is this your first enquiry?

turns.speaker: you
