turns.intent_zh: 說是第一次，你想加強口說
turns.answer: It's my first time. I mainly want to work on my speaking.
accept: It's my first time. I mainly want to work on my speaking.
First time — I'm looking to improve my speaking specifically.
turns.note_zh: work on something 是「加強某方面」，比 improve 口語。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: We'd start with a placement test. Have you taken any formal exams?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說兩年前考過多益，大概七百分
turns.answer: I took TOEIC about two years ago and got around seven hundred.
accept: I took TOEIC about two years ago and got around seven hundred.
I did TOEIC two years back, scoring roughly seven hundred.
turns.note_zh: 考試用 take，成績用 get 或 score。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That'd put you at intermediate. Our conversation class runs twice a week.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問一班大概幾個人
turns.answer: How many people are in a class?
accept: How many people are in a class?
What's the typical class size?
turns.note_zh: class size 是班級人數，口說課這點特別重要。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Maximum eight, usually six. Small enough that everyone speaks every session.

title: 跟鄰居借工具
setting_zh: 你要組裝家具但缺工具，去跟鄰居借。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Hi! Everything okay?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說不好意思打擾，想問有沒有電鑽可以借
turns.answer: Sorry to bother you — do you happen to have a drill I could borrow?
accept: Sorry to bother you — do you happen to have a drill I could borrow?
Hi, sorry to disturb you. Would you have a drill I could borrow?
turns.note_zh: do you happen to have 語氣輕鬆，讓對方比較好拒絕。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I do, somewhere in the garage. What are you putting up?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說一個書櫃，應該一小時就會還
turns.answer: A bookshelf. I should have it back to you within an hour.
accept: A bookshelf. I should have it back to you within an hour.
Just a bookshelf — I'll return it within the hour.
turns.note_zh: 主動說明何時歸還，是借東西的基本禮貌。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: No rush at all. Do you need wall plugs as well? Depends what your walls are made of.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說可能需要，你不確定牆是什麼材質
turns.answer: Probably, yes. I'm not sure what the walls are made of.
accept: Probably, yes. I'm not sure what the walls are made of.
I might do — I don't know what the walls are.
turns.note_zh: be made of 是「由什麼做成」，講材質時的固定用法。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I'll bring a few different ones over. Give me two minutes.

title: 訂位改人數
setting_zh: 你星期六訂了四個人的位子，但有兩個朋友也要來。你打電話到餐廳。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Good afternoon, Bruno's. How can I help?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你星期六七點有訂四位，想改成六位
turns.answer: I have a booking for four on Saturday at seven, and I'd like to make it six.
accept: I have a booking for four on Saturday at seven, and I'd like to make it six.
I have a booking for four at seven on Saturday. Could I make it six people?
turns.note_zh: booking 是英式的「訂位」，美式常說 reservation。make it six 是「改成六個」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Let me see. Six at seven is tight, but I could do six thirty. Would that work?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說六點半可以，並問可不可以坐外面
turns.answer: Six thirty works. Could we sit outside if the weather is okay?
accept: Six thirty works. Could we sit outside if the weather is okay?
Six thirty is fine. Is it possible to sit outside if the weather is okay?
turns.note_zh: works 在這裡是「可以、行得通」，比 I can 自然。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I'll note it down, but I can't promise the terrace. It goes on a first come basis.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說沒關係，並問要不要先付訂金
turns.answer: That's no problem. Do you need a deposit for a group of six?
accept: That's no problem. Do you need a deposit for a group of six?
That's no problem. Do you need a deposit for six people?
turns.note_zh: deposit 是訂金；問「需不需要」用 Do you need…？最直接。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Not for six, no. We'll see you Saturday at six thirty.

title: 點餐時說明過敏
setting_zh: 你對堅果過敏，要在餐廳點餐前先問清楚。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Are you ready to order, or do you need another minute?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你對堅果過敏，問哪些菜含堅果
turns.answer: Before I order, I have a nut allergy. Which dishes contain nuts?
accept: Before I order, I have a nut allergy. Which dishes contain nuts?
I have a nut allergy, so which dishes contain nuts?
turns.note_zh: I have a nut allergy 比 I can't eat nuts 更清楚，廚房會當成醫療需求處理。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: The satay and the pesto both do. The curry has cashews in the paste as well.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問烤魚是不是安全的，並提醒不要用同一個鍋子
turns.answer: Is the grilled fish safe, and could they cook it in a clean pan?
accept: Is the grilled fish safe, and could they cook it in a clean pan?
Is the grilled fish safe? Could the kitchen use a clean pan for it?
turns.note_zh: 交叉污染的問法就是問 a clean pan（乾淨的鍋子），不必解釋一長串。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Yes, and I'll flag the allergy on the ticket so the kitchen sees it.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 謝謝他，並說你就點烤魚配飯
turns.answer: Thank you. I'll have the grilled fish with rice, please.
accept: Thank you. I'll have the grilled fish with rice, please.
Thanks. I'll take the grilled fish with rice, please.
turns.note_zh: 點餐說 I'll have… 是最標準的說法，I want… 聽起來很生硬。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Great choice. I'll get that started for you.

title: 上錯菜
setting_zh: 服務生端來的不是你點的菜，而同桌朋友的湯還沒來。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Here you go, one chicken curry.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 客氣地說這不是你點的，你點的是羊肉
turns.answer: Sorry, I think there's been a mix up. I ordered the lamb.
accept: Sorry, I think there's been a mix up. I ordered the lamb.
Sorry, I think this is the wrong dish. I ordered the lamb.
turns.note_zh: a mix up 是「弄錯了」，比直接說 you got it wrong 更不帶指責。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Oh, I'm sorry about that. Let me take it back and check with the kitchen.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你可以等，但問朋友的湯還要多久
turns.answer: I don't mind waiting. How long will my friend's soup be?
accept: I don't mind waiting. How long will my friend's soup be?
I don't mind waiting. Do you know how long my friend's soup will be?
turns.note_zh: How long will it be? 是問「還要多久」，比 When will it come? 自然。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: It should be out in two minutes. I'll bring them together.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說這樣很好，並請他順便加一杯水
turns.answer: That would be great. Could we get some water as well?
accept: That would be great. Could we get some water as well?
That works, thanks. Could we also get some water?
turns.note_zh: as well 放句尾就是「順便也要」；也可以說 also，位置在動詞前。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Of course. Sorry again about the mix up.

title: 咖啡店外帶並問密碼
setting_zh: 你在咖啡店買一杯咖啡，想坐下來用電腦工作一下。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Hi! What can I get started for you?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 點一杯大杯的黑咖啡，內用
turns.answer: A large black coffee for here, please.
accept: A large black coffee for here, please.
Could I get a large black coffee for here, please?
turns.note_zh: for here 是內用、to go 是外帶，這兩個一定要記反面。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Sure, that's three eighty. Anything to eat?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 不用了，並問無線網路的密碼
turns.answer: No thanks. What's the wifi password?
accept: No thanks. What's the wifi password?
No thank you. Could I have the wifi password?
turns.note_zh: wifi 在英文裡唸成兩個音節（WAI-fai），不要唸成 wee-fee。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: It's on the receipt at the bottom. There's a two hour limit on it.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說知道了，並問附近有沒有插座
turns.answer: Good to know. Are there any power sockets near the window?
accept: Good to know. Are there any power sockets near the window?
Good to know. Is there a power socket near the window?
turns.note_zh: 插座英式叫 socket、美式叫 outlet；Good to know 是「知道了、謝謝告知」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Two by the window and one at the back. I'll bring your coffee over.

title: 外送少了東西
setting_zh: 你點的外送到了，但少了一份餐點。你打電話給店家。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Hello, Golden Wok. Is this about an order?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你剛收到外送，但少了一份炒飯
turns.answer: Yes, my delivery just arrived but the fried rice is missing.
accept: Yes, my delivery just arrived but the fried rice is missing.
Yes, my delivery just came and the fried rice is missing.
turns.note_zh: missing 是「不見了、沒附上」，比 you forgot it 更中性。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I'm sorry. Can you read me the order number on the receipt?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 唸出訂單號碼四七二一，並說希望退錢而不是重送
turns.answer: It's four seven two one. I'd rather have a refund than wait for it.
accept: It's four seven two one. I'd rather have a refund than wait for it.
It's four seven two one. I'd prefer a refund rather than waiting for it.
turns.note_zh: I'd rather A than B 是「寧可 A 不要 B」；rather 後面接原形動詞或名詞。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's fine. It'll go back to your card in three to five days.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問可不可以給你一封確認的信
turns.answer: Could you send me an email to confirm that?
accept: Could you send me an email to confirm that?
Could you email me to confirm that, please?
turns.note_zh: confirm 是「確認」，要書面憑證時就說 send me an email to confirm。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Will do. Again, sorry about that.

title: 分開結帳
setting_zh: 你和朋友吃完飯，想分開付帳。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Can I get you anything else, or shall I bring the bill?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 請他拿帳單，並問可不可以分開結
turns.answer: The bill, please. Could we split it two ways?
accept: The bill, please. Could we split it two ways?
Could we have the bill, please? Can we split it two ways?
turns.note_zh: split the bill 是分攤帳單；two ways 是「分成兩份」。美式常說 check 而不是 bill。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Sure. Do you want it exactly down the middle, or by what each of you had?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說各付自己吃的就好
turns.answer: By what each of us had, please.
accept: By what each of us had, please.
Just by what each of us had, please.
turns.note_zh: down the middle 是「對半分」；照各自吃的算就說 by what each of us had。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: No problem. Are you both paying by card?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你要刷卡，朋友付現
turns.answer: I'll pay by card and my friend is paying cash.
accept: I'll pay by card and my friend is paying cash.
I'll pay by card, and my friend will pay cash.
turns.note_zh: pay by card / pay cash 的介系詞不一樣：卡片用 by、現金可以不加。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Got it. I'll bring the machine over in a moment.

title: 退回不新鮮的東西
setting_zh: 你昨天在超市買的沙拉聞起來壞了，還沒過保存期限。你拿回去換。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Hi there, what can I do for you today?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說這盒沙拉是昨天買的，打開就聞到壞掉的味道
turns.answer: I bought this salad yesterday and it smells off, even though the date is fine.
accept: I bought this salad yesterday and it smells off, even though the date is fine.
I bought this salad yesterday. It smells off, even though the date is still fine.
turns.note_zh: 食物「壞了」最口語的說法是 it smells off 或 it's gone off，不是 it's broken。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That shouldn't happen. Do you have the receipt with you?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說收據在手機的 App 上，並問這樣可不可以
turns.answer: It's in the app on my phone. Is that okay?
accept: It's in the app on my phone. Is that okay?
The receipt is in the app on my phone. Will that do?
turns.note_zh: Will that do? 是「這樣可以嗎」的口語說法，跟 Is that okay? 一樣自然。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's fine. Would you like a refund or a replacement?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你想換一盒，但要先看一下架上那盒的日期
turns.answer: A replacement, but I'd like to check the date on the new one first.
accept: A replacement, but I'd like to check the date on the new one first.
I'd like a replacement, but let me check the date on the new one first.
turns.note_zh: replacement 是「換一個同樣的」，refund 是退錢，兩個要分清楚。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Of course, go ahead. I'll wait here and sort the paperwork.

title: 跟廚房要一點調整
setting_zh: 你想點菜單上的一道菜，但希望做一些調整。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Have you decided, or shall I give you another minute?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你要點雞肉義大利麵，但想把醬料換成番茄的
turns.answer: I'll have the chicken pasta, but could I swap the cream sauce for tomato?
accept: I'll have the chicken pasta, but could I swap the cream sauce for tomato?
Could I have the chicken pasta and swap the cream sauce for tomato?
turns.note_zh: swap A for B 是「把 A 換成 B」，餐廳裡最常用的換料說法。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I'll ask, but the cream sauce is made in advance, so it might be a no.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說如果不行的話，你就點烤雞配蔬菜
turns.answer: If they can't, I'll go for the roast chicken with vegetables instead.
accept: If they can't, I'll go for the roast chicken with vegetables instead.
If that's not possible, I'll have the roast chicken with vegetables instead.
turns.note_zh: go for something 是「就選那個」；instead 放句尾表示「改成這個」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Let me check with the kitchen and come straight back to you.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 謝謝他，並說你們不趕時間
turns.answer: Thanks, we're in no rush at all.
accept: Thanks, we're in no rush at all.
Thank you, there's no rush at all.
turns.note_zh: in no rush / no rush 都是「不急」，比 we have time 更道地。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Appreciate it. Back in a moment.

title: 換一件大一號的
setting_zh: 你買的襯衫太小，帶著收據回店裡換。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Hi, are you looking for anything in particular?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說這件襯衫太小，想換大一號的
turns.answer: This shirt is too small. Could I exchange it for a larger size?
accept: This shirt is too small. Could I exchange it for a larger size?
This shirt is too small, so could I exchange it for a larger size?
turns.note_zh: exchange 是「換貨」、refund 是退錢；a larger size 比 a bigger one 更常用在衣服上。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Of course. Do you have the receipt and are the tags still on?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說收據在這裡，吊牌也還在
turns.answer: Yes, here's the receipt and the tags are still on.
accept: Yes, here's the receipt and the tags are still on.
Yes, I have the receipt here and the tags are still on.
turns.note_zh: tags 是衣服上的吊牌；還沒剪掉就說 the tags are still on。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Perfect. We have a medium in navy, but the black is sold out.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說深藍色可以，並問其他分店有沒有黑色
turns.answer: Navy is fine. Could you check if another branch has the black?
accept: Navy is fine. Could you check if another branch has the black?
Navy is fine. Can you check whether another branch has the black one?
turns.note_zh: branch 是「分店」；請人幫忙查用 Could you check…？

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I can see two in stock in the city centre. Shall I hold one for you?

title: 問保固範圍
setting_zh: 你在電器行看一台吸塵器，想問清楚保固。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That model's very popular. Any questions about it?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問保固幾年，還有電池有沒有包含在裡面
turns.answer: How long is the warranty, and does it cover the battery?
accept: How long is the warranty, and does it cover the battery?
How long is the warranty? Does it cover the battery as well?
turns.note_zh: cover 是「保固涵蓋」；問範圍就用 does it cover…？

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Two years on the machine, but only one on the battery.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問延長保固要多少錢，以及什麼時候要決定
turns.answer: How much is the extended warranty, and when do I have to decide?
accept: How much is the extended warranty, and when do I have to decide?
How much does the extended warranty cost, and when do I need to decide?
turns.note_zh: extended warranty 是延長保固；問期限用 when do I have to…？

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Forty dollars, and you've got fourteen days from today to add it.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你先買機器，回去想一想再決定延長保固
turns.answer: I'll take the machine now and think about the warranty at home.
accept: I'll take the machine now and think about the warranty at home.
I'll buy the machine now and think about the warranty at home.
turns.note_zh: think about it 是「再考慮一下」，不想當場決定時最好用的一句。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: No problem at all. Keep the receipt and just come back in.

title: 網購少寄一樣
setting_zh: 你網購的兩件商品只到一件，你打客服電話。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Thanks for holding. How can I help today?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你訂了兩個杯子，只收到一個
turns.answer: I ordered two mugs but only one arrived.
accept: I ordered two mugs but only one arrived.
I ordered two mugs and only one arrived.
turns.note_zh: arrive 用在包裹或東西「送到」；不要說 came out。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I'm sorry. The system says both were packed together. Was the box damaged?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說箱子有一邊是開的，而且你拍了照
turns.answer: The box was open at one end, and I took photos of it.
accept: The box was open at one end, and I took photos of it.
The box was open at one end and I've taken photos of it.
turns.note_zh: at one end 是「其中一端」；描述包裝破損時很常用。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That helps. I can send a replacement or refund half the order.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你想要補寄一個，但問要多久才會到
turns.answer: I'd prefer a replacement. How long will it take to arrive?
accept: I'd prefer a replacement. How long will it take to arrive?
I'd rather have a replacement. How long will it take to arrive?
turns.note_zh: I'd prefer / I'd rather 都是「我比較想要」，後者要接原形動詞。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Two working days, and I'll email you the tracking number.

title: 殺價買展示品
setting_zh: 你想買的檯燈只剩展示品，上面有一點刮痕。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's the last one, I'm afraid. It's the one that's been on display.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 指出底座有刮痕，問這樣能不能算便宜一點
turns.answer: There are scratches on the base. Could you do anything on the price?
accept: There are scratches on the base. Could you do anything on the price?
There are scratches on the base, so could you do anything on the price?
turns.note_zh: Could you do anything on the price? 是很客氣的殺價說法，比 Give me a discount 好得多。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I can take ten percent off. That's what I'm allowed to do without asking.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問如果現金付款可不可以到十五趴
turns.answer: Would you go to fifteen percent if I pay in cash?
accept: Would you go to fifteen percent if I pay in cash?
Could you go to fifteen percent if I pay in cash?
turns.note_zh: Would you go to…？是「能不能到（某個數字）」，談價錢時很常聽到。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Let me ask my manager. Give me one second.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 謝謝他，並說如果可以你今天就帶走
turns.answer: Thanks. If she agrees, I'll take it today.
accept: Thanks. If she agrees, I'll take it today.
Thank you. If she agrees, I'll take it today.
turns.note_zh: take it 在買東西的語境就是「買下來、帶走」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: She says fifteen is fine if you take it as seen. Deal?

title: 超市找不到東西
setting_zh: 你在超市找不到你要的東西，問店員。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: You look lost. Can I point you somewhere?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問醬油放在哪一排
turns.answer: Which aisle is the soy sauce in?
accept: Which aisle is the soy sauce in?
Which aisle has the soy sauce?
turns.note_zh: aisle 的 s 不發音（唸 /aɪl/），是超市的「走道、貨架排」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Aisle seven with the world foods, next to the rice.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 再問哪裡有無糖的優格
turns.answer: And where can I find the yoghurt without sugar?
accept: And where can I find the yoghurt without sugar?
Where can I find the yoghurt without sugar?
turns.note_zh: Where can I find…？是問位置最實用的句型，比 Where is…？更禮貌。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Back wall, in the chiller. The plain ones are on the bottom shelf.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 謝謝他，並問結帳的隊伍是不是那邊比較短
turns.answer: Thanks. Is the queue shorter over there?
accept: Thanks. Is the queue shorter over there?
Thank you. Is the queue shorter over there?
turns.note_zh: queue 是英式的「排隊、隊伍」，美式說 line。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Usually, yes. The self checkouts move faster this time of day.

title: 問寄送時間
setting_zh: 你在家具店買了一張桌子，要安排送貨。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Right, the table. Would you like to arrange delivery?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問最早哪一天可以送，還有時段有多長
turns.answer: What's the earliest date, and how long is the delivery window?
accept: What's the earliest date, and how long is the delivery window?
What is the earliest date, and how long is the delivery window?
turns.note_zh: delivery window 是「送貨的時間區間」，不是窗戶。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Thursday, and it's a four hour window. Two hours costs extra.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說星期四可以，並問他們會不會搬到樓上
turns.answer: Thursday is fine. Will they carry it upstairs?
accept: Thursday is fine. Will they carry it upstairs?
Thursday works. Will they carry it upstairs?
turns.note_zh: carry it upstairs 是「搬上樓」；如果要問組裝就說 assemble it。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: They'll bring it to the door of the flat, but they won't assemble it.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問組裝要另外多少錢
turns.answer: How much extra is assembly?
accept: How much extra is assembly?
How much more is assembly?
turns.note_zh: assembly 是名詞的「組裝」；動詞是 assemble。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Thirty dollars, and you book it on the same delivery slot.

title: 退款進度追蹤
setting_zh: 你兩週前退了貨，錢還沒回到卡裡。你打電話追。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Hello, customer service. What's it regarding?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你兩週前退貨了，但退款還沒進來
turns.answer: I returned an item two weeks ago and the refund hasn't come through.
accept: I returned an item two weeks ago and the refund hasn't come through.
I returned an item two weeks ago, but the refund hasn't come through yet.
turns.note_zh: come through 用在款項「進來、下來了」，比 arrive 更常見於錢。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Let me look. I can see it was received, but it wasn't processed. Sorry about that.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問現在處理要多久，還有錢會退到哪裡
turns.answer: How long will it take now, and where will the money go?
accept: How long will it take now, and where will the money go?
How long does it take now, and where will the money go?
turns.note_zh: 問退款去哪就說 where will the money go，不必講一長串帳戶細節。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I'll push it through today. Three to five days back onto the original card.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 請他給你一個處理編號，方便之後再問
turns.answer: Could I have a reference number in case I need to call again?
accept: Could I have a reference number in case I need to call again?
Can I have a reference number in case I need to call back?
turns.note_zh: reference number 是客服的「案件編號」；in case… 是「以防之後需要」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Of course. It's R as in Robert, four four nine one.

title: 問可不可以試穿兩件
setting_zh: 你想試穿兩件外套，找店員問試衣間。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Let me know if you'd like to try anything on.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問可不可以試穿這兩件外套
turns.answer: Could I try these two jackets on?
accept: Could I try these two jackets on?
Can I try these two jackets on, please?
turns.note_zh: try something on 是「試穿」，代名詞要放中間：try it on。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Sure, the fitting rooms are just behind you. Take this tag with you.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問這兩件的尺寸是不是一樣的版型
turns.answer: Do these two come up the same size?
accept: Do these two come up the same size?
Do these two jackets come up the same size?
turns.note_zh: come up small / big / true to size 是講「版型偏小或偏大」的固定說法。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: The grey one comes up small, so you might want the next size up.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 請他幫你拿一件大一號的灰色
turns.answer: Could you get me the grey one a size up?
accept: Could you get me the grey one a size up?
Could you bring me the grey one a size up?
turns.note_zh: a size up 是「大一號」，a size down 是「小一號」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: On it. I'll hand it to you at the fitting room.

title: 藥局買感冒藥
setting_zh: 你喉嚨痛了兩天，到藥局請藥師推薦成藥。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Hi there, are you looking for something in particular?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你喉嚨痛了兩天，想找不會讓人想睡的藥
turns.answer: My throat has been sore for two days and I need something non-drowsy.
accept: My throat has been sore for two days and I need something non-drowsy.
My throat has been sore for two days, so I need something non-drowsy.
turns.note_zh: non-drowsy 是藥盒上的固定用字（不嗜睡），比 not sleepy 自然得多。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: These lozenges should help. One every three hours, up to eight a day.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問可不可以跟你在吃的維他命一起吃
turns.answer: Can I take these with my vitamins?
accept: Can I take these with my vitamins?
Is it okay to take these with my vitamins?
turns.note_zh: 吃藥的動詞是 take，不是 eat；問並用就說 take A with B。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's fine. If it's not better in five days, see a doctor.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 謝謝他，並問這個牌子有沒有比較便宜的同款
turns.answer: Thanks. Is there a cheaper version of the same thing?
accept: Thanks. Is there a cheaper version of the same thing?
Thank you. Is there a cheaper version of the same thing?
turns.note_zh: 問學名藥或自有品牌就說 a cheaper version，店員會知道你的意思。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: The own brand next to it is half the price and the same dose.

title: 掛號看醫生
setting_zh: 你打電話到診所要掛號。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Good morning, Riverside Clinic.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你想約這禮拜看醫生
turns.answer: I'd like to make an appointment this week, please.
accept: I'd like to make an appointment this week, please.
I'd like to book an appointment this week, please.
turns.note_zh: make / book an appointment 都可以；appointment 是有預約的看診。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: We have Wednesday at four or Friday morning. Which suits you better?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說星期三比較好，並問可不可以晚一點
turns.answer: Wednesday is better. Is there anything later in the day?
accept: Wednesday is better. Is there anything later in the day?
Wednesday works better. Is there anything later in the day?
turns.note_zh: Is there anything later? 是問「有沒有更晚的時段」，很實用的一句。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Five fifteen is the last one. Can I take your date of birth?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你的生日是三月十二日，並問要不要帶什麼
turns.answer: It's the twelfth of March. Do I need to bring anything?
accept: It's the twelfth of March. Do I need to bring anything?
The twelfth of March. Do I need to bring anything?
turns.note_zh: 英式日期唸法是 the twelfth of March；美式常說 March twelfth。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Just a list of any medication you're taking. See you Wednesday.

title: 描述症狀
setting_zh: 你頭痛了一個星期，在診間跟醫生說明。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: So what's been going on?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你頭痛快一個星期了，主要在下午發作
turns.answer: I've had a headache for almost a week, mostly in the afternoon.
accept: I've had a headache for almost a week, mostly in the afternoon.
I've had a headache for nearly a week, mostly in the afternoon.
turns.note_zh: 持續到現在的症狀用現在完成式 I've had…，不要用 I had。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Is it on one side or all over? And does light bother you?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說是在額頭附近，像一種壓迫感，光線不會不舒服
turns.answer: It's around my forehead, more like pressure, and light doesn't bother me.
accept: It's around my forehead, more like pressure, and light doesn't bother me.
It's around my forehead, more like pressure. Light doesn't bother me.
turns.note_zh: 描述痛的感覺：pressure（壓迫）、throbbing（一陣一陣）、sharp（刺痛）。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Any changes in sleep, screen time, or how much water you drink?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你最近睡得比較少，而且一直在看螢幕
turns.answer: I've been sleeping less and looking at screens all day.
accept: I've been sleeping less and looking at screens all day.
I've been sleeping less and staring at screens all day.
turns.note_zh: I've been + Ving 表示「最近一直在」，正好用來講生活習慣的變化。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That fits a tension headache. Let's start there and check again in two weeks.

title: 拿慢性處方藥
setting_zh: 你要在藥局領固定服用的處方藥。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Name and date of birth, please.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你是來領固定的處方藥，姓陳
turns.answer: It's Chen, and I'm here to pick up my repeat prescription.
accept: It's Chen, and I'm here to pick up my repeat prescription.
Chen. I'm here to pick up my repeat prescription.
turns.note_zh: repeat prescription 是「長期重複領的處方」；領藥用 pick up。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I've got two of the three items. The inhaler isn't in yet.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問吸入器什麼時候會到，要不要再跑一趟
turns.answer: When will the inhaler be in, and do I have to come back?
accept: When will the inhaler be in, and do I have to come back?
When will the inhaler be in? Do I need to come back?
turns.note_zh: be in 在店裡的語境是「進貨、到了」；come back 是再來一趟。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Tomorrow afternoon. We can text you when it lands, or deliver it.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說請他們寄簡訊，你自己來拿
turns.answer: Please text me and I'll come in for it.
accept: Please text me and I'll come in for it.
Text me, please, and I'll come in for it.
turns.note_zh: text me 是「傳簡訊給我」，text 當動詞用；come in for it 是「進來拿」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Done. Here are the other two, and the label's on the bag.

title: 取消看牙的預約
setting_zh: 你臨時要出差，得取消明天的牙醫預約。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Hello, Bright Dental. How can I help?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你要取消明天下午兩點的預約
turns.answer: I need to cancel my appointment tomorrow at two.
accept: I need to cancel my appointment tomorrow at two.
I'd like to cancel my appointment tomorrow at two.
turns.note_zh: cancel 是取消、reschedule 是改期，取消要收費時他們會告知。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's less than twenty four hours, so there may be a fee. Can you come another day this week?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問可不可以改成下星期一，因為你要出差
turns.answer: Could you move it to next Monday? I'm away on a work trip.
accept: Could you move it to next Monday? I'm away on a work trip.
Could you move it to next Monday? I'll be away on a work trip.
turns.note_zh: move it to… 是「改到某個時間」，比 change 更口語；away 是「不在、出門」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Monday at eleven then, and I'll waive the fee this time.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 謝謝他，並請他寄一封確認信
turns.answer: Thank you. Could you email me a confirmation?
accept: Thank you. Could you email me a confirmation?
Thanks. Could you send me a confirmation by email?
turns.note_zh: waive the fee 是「免收費用」；confirmation 是確認信或確認訊息。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: It's on its way. See you Monday at eleven.

title: 健身房入會
setting_zh: 你到健身房櫃檯問入會的方案。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Are you here to join, or just having a look?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問月繳的方案多少錢，還有有沒有綁約
turns.answer: How much is the monthly plan, and is there a contract?
accept: How much is the monthly plan, and is there a contract?
How much does the monthly plan cost, and is there a contract?
turns.note_zh: contract 在這裡是「綁約」；問可不可以隨時退就說 Can I cancel any time?

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Thirty a month rolling, or twenty five if you commit to a year.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你想先試一個月，並問課程有沒有另外收費
turns.answer: I'll start with the rolling one. Are the classes included?
accept: I'll start with the rolling one. Are the classes included?
I'd like to start with the rolling one. Are the classes included?
turns.note_zh: rolling（monthly）是「月繳、隨時可停」；included 是「有沒有含在裡面」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: All included, but you book them on the app. They fill up two days ahead.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問新手導覽要怎麼約
turns.answer: How do I book the induction?
accept: How do I book the induction?
How can I book the induction?
turns.note_zh: induction 是健身房或工作的「新手說明、入門導覽」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I'll put you down for Thursday at six. Bring a towel, that's a rule.

title: 受傷後問復健
setting_zh: 你腳踝扭傷，在物理治療室問接下來怎麼練。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: The swelling's gone down nicely. How does it feel walking?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說平路可以走，但下樓梯還是會痛
turns.answer: Flat ground is okay, but going down stairs still hurts.
accept: Flat ground is okay, but going down stairs still hurts.
Flat ground is fine, but going down stairs still hurts.
turns.note_zh: hurt 可以當動詞用（it hurts），不必說 it's painful。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's normal at this stage. I'd like you doing the balance exercises daily.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問一天要做幾分鐘，還有多久可以開始跑步
turns.answer: How many minutes a day, and when can I start running again?
accept: How many minutes a day, and when can I start running again?
How many minutes a day? And when can I start running again?
turns.note_zh: 問恢復時程就說 when can I start… again，醫療人員最常聽到的問法。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Ten minutes a day, and running in about three weeks if there's no sharp pain.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問哪一種痛是要停下來的警訊
turns.answer: Which kind of pain means I should stop?
accept: Which kind of pain means I should stop?
What kind of pain means I should stop?
turns.note_zh: sharp pain（刺痛）跟 aching（痠）是兩件事，問清楚很重要。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Aching afterwards is fine. Sharp pain during, stop and let me know.

title: 打疫苗前問問題
setting_zh: 你到藥局打流感疫苗，先問幾個問題。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Right, flu jab. Have you had one before?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說去年打過，那次手痠了兩天
turns.answer: I had one last year and my arm ached for two days.
accept: I had one last year and my arm ached for two days.
I had one last year, and my arm ached for two days.
turns.note_zh: ache 是「痠痛」，動詞與名詞同形；jab 是英式口語的「打針」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That's a common reaction and nothing to worry about.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問今天打完可不可以照常運動
turns.answer: Can I still exercise today after the jab?
accept: Can I still exercise today after the jab?
Is it okay to exercise today after the jab?
turns.note_zh: exercise 當動詞就是「運動」，不必說 do exercise。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Light exercise is fine. I'd skip heavy weights tonight.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問要多久才有保護力
turns.answer: How long does it take to work?
accept: How long does it take to work?
How long before it starts to work?
turns.note_zh: 藥或疫苗「生效」就用 work，不要用 be useful。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: About two weeks for full protection. Roll your sleeve up for me.

title: 請老師延一下期限
setting_zh: 你的報告寫不完，去老師的辦公時間問能不能延。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Come in. What can I do for you?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問報告可不可以延兩天交，並說明你已經寫了三分之二
turns.answer: Could I have two more days for the essay? I've written about two thirds.
accept: Could I have two more days for the essay? I've written about two thirds.
Could I get two more days for the essay? I've written about two thirds.
turns.note_zh: 要延期就講清楚要幾天（two more days），並附上目前的進度，比只說 I need more time 有說服力。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: I can give you until Monday, but the late penalty starts after that.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說星期一可以，並問參考書目的格式要用哪一種
turns.answer: Monday works. Which referencing style should I use?
accept: Monday works. Which referencing style should I use?
Monday is fine. Which referencing style should I use?
turns.note_zh: referencing style 是「引用格式」（APA、Chicago 之類）。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Author and date in the text, full list at the end. Page numbers only for direct quotes.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 謝謝老師，並問可不可以先寄大綱給他看
turns.answer: Thank you. Could I send you my outline first?
accept: Thank you. Could I send you my outline first?
Thanks. Could I email you my outline first?
turns.note_zh: outline 是「大綱」；先寄大綱比寫完再改省力，也是老師樂意看到的做法。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Send it by Thursday and I'll have a quick look.

title: 圖書館借書逾期
setting_zh: 你的書逾期了，到圖書館櫃檯處理。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Hi, are you returning those?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說這兩本逾期了，問罰款多少
turns.answer: Yes, these two are overdue. How much is the fine?
accept: Yes, these two are overdue. How much is the fine?
Yes, these two are late. How much is the fine?
turns.note_zh: overdue 是「逾期」；fine 當名詞是「罰款」，不是「還好」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Four days over, so eighty cents. Do you want to pay now?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你要現在付，並問另外一本可不可以續借
turns.answer: I'll pay now. Can I renew the other one?
accept: I'll pay now. Can I renew the other one?
I'll pay now. Could I renew the other one?
turns.note_zh: renew 是「續借」；別人預約了就不能續借（see 下面館員的回答）。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: That one's been requested by someone else, so no. It's due back Friday.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問館內可不可以讀，因為你只需要一章
turns.answer: Can I read it in the library? I only need one chapter.
accept: Can I read it in the library? I only need one chapter.
Could I read it in the library? I only need one chapter.
turns.note_zh: in the library 是「館內閱覽」；短期借閱的書通常不能帶走但可以在館內看。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Always. There's a scanner on the second floor if you need a copy.

title: 跟組員分工
setting_zh: 你和同學要做三人一組的報告，你們在討論怎麼分。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: So how do we want to split this up?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 提議一人做一段，最後互相校稿
turns.answer: How about one section each, then we proofread each other's at the end?
accept: How about one section each, then we proofread each other's at the end?
How about we each take one section and proofread each other's at the end?
turns.note_zh: How about…？用來提議很自然；proofread 是「校稿」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Works for me. I'd rather not do the data one though.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你可以做資料那段，因為你有那個軟體
turns.answer: I can take the data section. I already have the software.
accept: I can take the data section. I already have the software.
I'll take the data section. I already have the software.
turns.note_zh: take a section 是「認領一段」；already 放在 have 前面。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Great. When should we have first drafts done?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 提議下週三先交草稿，這樣還有兩天可以改
turns.answer: Let's aim for Wednesday, so we still have two days to fix things.
accept: Let's aim for Wednesday, so we still have two days to fix things.
Let's aim for Wednesday so we have two days left to fix things.
turns.note_zh: aim for + 時間 是「目標訂在」，比 must finish 有彈性又清楚。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Wednesday it is. I'll set up the shared folder tonight.

title: 問選課
setting_zh: 你在兩門選修之間猶豫，找助教問。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: You wanted to ask about the electives?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問這兩門課是怎麼評分的
turns.answer: How are the two courses assessed?
accept: How are the two courses assessed?
How is each of the two courses assessed?
turns.note_zh: assess 是「評量、計分」；問考試還是報告就用 How is it assessed?

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Statistics is two tests. Media is one long essay plus a presentation.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你不太喜歡上台報告，問統計那門要不要修過先修課
turns.answer: I'd rather not present. Do I need any prerequisites for statistics?
accept: I'd rather not present. Do I need any prerequisites for statistics?
I'd prefer not to present. Do I need any prerequisites for statistics?
turns.note_zh: prerequisite 是「先修課、必備條件」；present 當動詞是「上台報告」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: No prerequisites, but there's a maths refresher in week one you should attend.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問什麼時候要決定，還有名額什麼時候發
turns.answer: When do I have to decide, and when are the places given out?
accept: When do I have to decide, and when are the places given out?
When do I need to decide, and when are the places given out?
turns.note_zh: places 在選課的語境是「名額」；give out 是「發放」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Places go out Monday morning, so decide over the weekend.

title: 報名短期課程
setting_zh: 你打電話到社區大學報名一門晚間課程。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Community College, how can I help?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你想報名星期二晚上的攝影課
turns.answer: I'd like to sign up for the Tuesday evening photography class.
accept: I'd like to sign up for the Tuesday evening photography class.
I'd like to enrol in the Tuesday evening photography class.
turns.note_zh: sign up for 是報名；enrol（美式 enroll）比較正式，兩個都通。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: There are four places left. It's ten weeks, sixty dollars.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問學生有沒有優惠，還有什麼時候付錢
turns.answer: Is there a student discount, and when do I pay?
accept: Is there a student discount, and when do I pay?
Is there a student discount? And when do I pay?
turns.note_zh: student discount 是學生優惠；問付款時間用 when do I pay?

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Forty for students, and you pay at the first session, not now.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問要不要自己帶相機
turns.answer: Do I need to bring my own camera?
accept: Do I need to bring my own camera?
Should I bring my own camera?
turns.note_zh: my own + 名詞 是「自己的」；問要帶什麼就用 Do I need to bring…？

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: A phone camera is fine for the first few weeks. I'll put your name down.

title: 問報告的回饋
setting_zh: 你的期中報告拿到分數，想問可以怎麼改進。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: You wanted to talk about the feedback?

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你看了評語，想問下一次可以怎麼把論點寫得更清楚
turns.answer: I read your comments. How can I make the argument clearer next time?
accept: I read your comments. How can I make the argument clearer next time?
I've read your comments. How can I make the argument clearer next time?
turns.note_zh: 問「怎麼改進」比問「為什麼只給這個分數」有用得多，老師也比較願意講細節。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Put your position in the first paragraph. At the moment it arrives on page three.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問那前面那段文獻回顧要不要縮短
turns.answer: Should I cut down the literature review then?
accept: Should I cut down the literature review then?
Should I shorten the literature review then?
turns.note_zh: cut down 是「縮短、砍掉一些」；literature review 是「文獻回顧」。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Cut most of it, and use the space to answer the counterargument properly.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問可不可以下次交之前先給他看兩頁
turns.answer: Could I show you two pages before I hand it in next time?
accept: Could I show you two pages before I hand it in next time?
Could I show you a couple of pages before I hand it in next time?
turns.note_zh: hand in 是「交作業」；先給老師看一部分是很常見的請求。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Bring them to office hours and we'll go through them.

title: 線上課程的技術問題
setting_zh: 你上線上課時聽不到聲音，跟助教說。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Can everyone hear me? Say something in the chat if not.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你聽不到聲音，但看得到投影片
turns.answer: I can't hear anything, but I can see the slides.
accept: I can't hear anything, but I can see the slides.
I can't hear any sound, but I can see the slides.
turns.note_zh: 描述線上會議的問題就分開講「聽得到嗎」「看得到嗎」，最快找到問題在哪。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Try leaving and rejoining. It fixes it nine times out of ten.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說你試過了還是一樣，問有沒有錄影
turns.answer: I tried that and it's still the same. Will the session be recorded?
accept: I tried that and it's still the same. Will the session be recorded?
I've tried that and it's still the same. Will the session be recorded?
turns.note_zh: recorded 是「有錄影」；問錄影檔用 Will it be recorded?

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Yes, it goes up on the course page within a day.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 說那你先看聊天室跟著，晚點看錄影
turns.answer: I'll follow the chat for now and watch the recording later.
accept: I'll follow the chat for now and watch the recording later.
I'll follow along in the chat for now and watch the recording later.
turns.note_zh: for now 是「暫時、先這樣」；the recording 是錄影檔本身。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Good plan. Post your questions in the chat and I'll answer them there.

title: 實驗課的安全問題
setting_zh: 實驗課開始前，你有幾件事要確認。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Before anyone touches anything, goggles on and hair tied back.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問洗眼器在哪裡
turns.answer: Where's the nearest eyewash station?
accept: Where's the nearest eyewash station?
Where is the nearest eyewash station?
turns.note_zh: the nearest… 是「最近的」；實驗室的安全設備位置一定要先問清楚。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: By the door you came in through. There's a shower next to it.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問如果打翻了東西該怎麼做
turns.answer: What should I do if I spill something?
accept: What should I do if I spill something?
What do I do if I spill something?
turns.note_zh: spill 是「打翻、濺出來」；過去式 spilled 或 spilt 都可以。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: Step back and tell me. Don't try to wipe it up yourself.

turns.speaker: you
turns.intent_zh: 問結果要記在哪裡，還有要不要拍照
turns.answer: Where do we record the results, and should we take photos?
accept: Where do we record the results, and should we take photos?
Where should we record the results, and should we take photos?
turns.note_zh: record 當動詞是「記錄」；results 是實驗結果，通常用複數。

turns.speaker: partner
turns.en: In the sheet on your bench. Photos are useful for the write up.
